title: Quality Assurance Team Lead (KYC/KYB Experience)
description:
Key Responsibilities

– Build and implement the KYC/KYB QA framework, including sampling, scoring and review methodology. Design the QA framework from the ground up, a risk-weighted sampling approach (higher-risk cases reviewed more frequently than lower-risk ones), a scoring methodology that captures both document completeness and the quality of the risk judgment behind it, and a review cadence that scales as case volume grows.

– Conduct quality reviews of KYC/KYB, CDD and EDD cases, including higher-risk customers. Independently review completed onboarding files checking risk-tier accuracy, screening disposition, source of funds/wealth evidencing, and (for entity clients) whether ownership structures were properly unwrapped to identify beneficial owners. Higher-risk and EDD cases receive closer scrutiny given the greater consequence of getting them wrong.

– Identify errors, trends and root causes and recommend improvements. Go beyond flagging individual mistakes — group findings by root cause (e.g. a documentation gap vs. a genuine risk judgment error vs. a partner-specific requirement being missed) so fixes target the actual cause, whether that's a training gap, an SOP gap, or a partner requirement that isn't properly documented.

– Develop QA reporting, KPIs and management information for the Head of Compliance.

– Own a regular reporting cadence covering quality trends, recurring error types, and partner specific RFI patterns — feeding a core KPI: reducing avoidable back-and-forth with our banking partners by catching issues before submission, not after.

– Work closely with the Head of Compliance to improve processes and controls.

– Act as the operational link between the compliance policy framework and how the team actually executes day to day — flagging where documented process and real practice have drifted apart, and helping close that gap.

– Identify training needs and provide feedback to onboarding teams.

– Use QA findings to drive what training actually happens — not generic refreshers, but targeted sessions addressing the specific gaps the data is showing (e.g. a pattern of source of funds vs. source of wealth confusion, or inconsistent handling of layered ownership structures).

– Continuously improve the QA framework as the business grows.

– Evolve the framework as new banking partners, products, or entity types are added.



Qualifications

– Must have at least 3 years of QA KYC team lead experience

– Must have experience in KYC, AML, Compliance or Financial Crime QA within fintech, payments or financial services.

– Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and risk-based onboarding.

– Direct, hands-on experience assessing KYC/KYB case quality (not general customer support QA experience). This role needs someone who can independently judge whether a compliance decision was right, not just whether a process step was followed.

– Experience building a QA framework from scratch. (This is a build role, not a maintain role. The successful candidate has built up a QA function before, not just operated within an existing one

– Strong understanding of QA methodologies, scorecard design, and performance evaluation.

– Comfortable designing scoring criteria that are consistent and defensible across reviewers, and calibrating so different reviewers reach the same conclusion on the same file.

– Genuine technical depth, able to independently assess whether a risk tier was applied correctly, whether EDD was sufficient, and whether an ownership structure was properly unwrapped, not just whether a checklist was completed.

– Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Able to turn QA findings into practical process improvements/training

– QA findings are only useful if they change something, this role needs to turn patterns into concrete process, training, or policy recommendations, not just produce reports.

– Confident, challenging decisions and escalating issues. This role will sometimes need to tell an experienced analyst, or flag to the Head of Compliance, that something isn't good enough.

– The end output of QA work here isn't a report that sits unread — it's a training session, an SOP update, or a process fix that actually closes the gap that was found.

– Must be comfortable using their own equipment

– Must be comfortable working Dubai hours

– Must be able to commit to working exclusively with the company and not be engaged in any part-time employment

– If you’ve read carefully the entire job description, please message us your updated CV with “QA Team Lead with KYC Experience” as the message subject

title: Lead Generation & Digital Marketing Specialist – Real Estate Rentals & Airbnb
description:
Lead Generation & Digital Marketing Specialist – Real Estate Rentals & Airbnb



Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | U.S. Real Estate Company



We are an established and growing Miami-based real estate investment and property management company seeking an exceptional Lead Generation and Digital Marketing Specialist.



Our company owns and manages approximately 100 residential rental units, including multifamily apartments, single-family homes, affordable housing, and short-term vacation rentals. We are looking for someone who can help us generate more qualified prospective tenants for our vacant rental properties and increase bookings and occupancy for our Airbnb vacation rentals.



This is not simply a social media posting position. We need someone who understands how to actually generate real leads, convert them into customers, track results, and continuously improve performance. We are NOT looking for someone to simply post content on social media. Instead we are looking for someone who can actually general real leads that will convert into actual revenue. 



We are looking for a resourceful, highly motivated professional who can work independently, take initiative, and deliver measurable results.



Responsibilities:



Residential Rental Lead Generation

Develop and execute strategies to generate qualified prospective tenants for our available rental properties.

Create and manage advertising campaigns on
, Instagram, Google, and other appropriate platforms.

Improve performance of rental listings on Zillow, 
, 
, and other rental websites.

Develop marketing strategies to reach prospective Section 8 and other qualified renters.

Identify additional tenant referral sources, including housing organizations, relocation services, and local referral partners.

Create landing pages, lead forms, and automated follow-up campaigns.

Track lead sources, cost per lead, appointments, applications, and signed leases.

Test different advertising campaigns, messages, and marketing channels to improve results.



Short-Term Rental Marketing

Develop strategies to increase bookings, occupancy, and revenue for our Airbnb vacation rentals.

Improve Airbnb and VRBO listings, descriptions, photographs, search visibility, and conversion rates.

Develop direct-booking and repeat-guest marketing strategies.

Identify opportunities for Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO,
 marketing, and other channels.

Research competitors and identify opportunities to improve performance.

Coordinate marketing initiatives with our property management team.



Marketing & Reporting:



Create and manage marketing campaigns from start to finish.

Track performance using Google Analytics, advertising dashboards, spreadsheets, and other tools.

Provide weekly reports showing results, costs, conversions, and recommendations.

Continuously test new ideas and identify opportunities for improvement.

Use AI and automation tools to improve productivity and marketing effectiveness.



Required Qualifications:



At least 3 years of relevant digital marketing or lead generation experience.

Demonstrated success generating qualified leads through paid advertising, organic marketing, or both.

Strong experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, or other performance marketing channels.

Experience tracking conversions, analyzing results, and improving campaign performance.

Excellent English communication skills.

Strong research, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

Strong proficiency with AI tools and modern marketing technology.



Preferred Qualifications:



Real estate rental lead generation experience.

Property management and/or property leasing experience.

Airbnb, VRBO, vacation rental, or hospitality marketing experience.

Experience with SEO, Google Business Profile, landing pages, and conversion optimization.

Experience with CRM systems and automated lead follow-up.

Spanish language proficiency.



What We're Looking For:



We want someone who takes ownership of results rather than simply completing assigned tasks. You should be proactive, creative, analytical, reliable, and constantly looking for better ways to generate business. We value honesty, initiative, attention to detail, excellent communication, and long-term commitment. This is an opportunity to grow with an established real estate company and potentially take on greater marketing responsibility over time.



Compensation is competitive and based on experience and demonstrated results.



Application Questions - please read the instructions and questions very carefully, as you will be evaluated on your answers, experience, and attention to detail. And begin your application with the words "Miami Growth" so we can see you''re paying attention to detail. 



Please answer the following questions when applying with numbered answers corresponding to the question numbers:



1. Describe your three most successful lead generation campaigns. What industry were they for, what was your role, and what measurable results did you achieve?



2. Have you generated leads for residential rental properties, real estate, or vacation rentals? Please describe your experience.



3. What advertising platforms have you personally managed, and approximately how much advertising budget have you managed per month?



4. Provide an example of a campaign that performed poorly. What did you change, and what happened afterward?



5. Have you helped increase Airbnb or vacation rental bookings? If so, explain exactly what you did and the results.



6. Please provide links or screenshots of previous work or campaign results, with confidential information removed.



7. What is your expected hourly rate, availability, and preferred long-term work arrangement?



Please begin your application with the words "Miami Growth" so we know you've read the posting carefully. We are looking for a long-term team member, not someone who is simply seeking another short-term project.

title: Customer Support & Community Manager with Startup Growth Experience – AI Video SaaS

ABOUT US

Clippie AI (clippie.ai) is a fast-growing AI platform that helps creators make faceless short-form videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. We're a small, lean team, and much of our customer community lives on Discord. We're looking for one proactive, reliable person to own customer support and help us grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO



Customer Service & Support

- Answer customer questions by Discord quickly and accurately

- Troubleshoot common issues (account, billing, video generation problems) and escalate bugs to the team with clear details

- Handle refund, cancellation and subscription questions professionally

- Build and maintain FAQ and help documentation from recurring questions



Community Building

Marketing & Growth

- Track simple metrics (response times, common issues, community activity) and report weekly

- Help find winning campaigns for us to target

- 1+ years of customer support experience, ideally for a SaaS or tech product

- Experience in marketing or growth for a startup (please give specific examples)

- Excellent written and spoken English with a friendly, clear tone

- Proactive. You take ownership and don't wait to be told what to do

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly

NICE TO HAVE

- Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels

SCHEDULE

Full-time, 40 hours per week. Some overlap with UK/US hours is required. Exact schedule to be agreed.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed.

title: Neon Sign Designer
description:
Role: Neon Sign Designer — Design Mockups & Production Files



Location: Remote — Filipino contractor

Hours: Full-time — Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm AEST

Rate: From $10 AUD/hr on a contractor basis



⚠ CorelDRAW proficiency is non-negotiable. This is a specialist role requiring genuine understanding of neon signage design and the manufacturing process — tube types, sizing specs, production file standards and CNC/laser cutting requirements. Applications without a portfolio of neon sign mockups and production files will not be considered.





About the Role

We are looking for a specialist Neon Sign Designer who genuinely understands the design and manufacturing process — not just graphic design.

This is a full-time role, Monday to Friday, 9am–6pm AEST. You'll be working directly with the team to produce high-quality neon sign designs from brief through to production-ready output. You need to understand how neon signs are actually made — the materials, the tube specifications, the tolerances and what makes a file manufacturer-ready.





What You'll Be Doing

Design ultra-realistic neon sign mockups for client review and approval

Produce accurate, production-ready PDF files for neon sign manufacturing

Work from client briefs — take direction clearly and translate it into polished design output

Apply technical knowledge of neon sign manufacturing — tube types, sizing, backing boards, CNC and laser cutting requirements

Use CorelDRAW as the primary tool for all production files

Use Adobe Illustrator for mockup creation, vector work and visual presentation

Manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver consistently to deadlines

Communicate clearly and professionally with the team throughout each project





What We're Looking For

Must Have

CorelDRAW — proficient. Primary tool for all production files. Non-negotiable.

Adobe Illustrator — proficient for realistic mockup creation, vector work and visual presentation

Genuine neon sign design experience — understands the design and manufacturing process end to end

Production-ready file creation — accurate, manufacturer-ready PDF output with correct specs

Ultra-realistic neon sign mockup creation — can present designs compellingly for client approval

Deep technical knowledge of neon sign manufacturing — tube types, materials, sizing and when different specs are used

Understanding of spacing and bleed tolerances between tubes and how these affect production files

Knowledge of tube path layout and how designs are structured for bending and manufacturing

Understanding of CNC and laser cutting requirements — knows how backing boards are cut and how files must be prepared

Production file accuracy — knows what makes a file truly manufacturer-ready, not just visually correct

Detail-oriented — production files must be exact. Errors cost money in manufacturing.

Self-managed and reliable — delivers consistently to deadlines without constant follow-up

Strong English communication — professional and clear throughout

Strong overall graphic design foundation

Bonus Points

Experience working directly with neon sign manufacturers or signage businesses

Experience with LED neon or flexible neon sign production

Experience designing signage for retail, hospitality or events









What to Include in Your Application

1.  Your CV or resume

2.  Portfolio — neon sign mockups and production files you have created

3.  Show us both the client-facing mockup and the production-ready output where possible

4.  A short note on your neon sign design experience and your understanding of the manufacturing process — tube types, sizing, spacing, CNC/laser file prep

5.  Your CorelDRAW proficiency level and version you work in



Applications without a neon sign design portfolio will not be considered. If you don't have genuine neon sign experience — including knowledge of the technical and manufacturing side — do not apply. You will not progress past the first stage of screening.

**Working Hours:** U.S. Pacific Time  

**Industry:** Life Insurance / Financial Services



## About the Position



We are a growing U.S.-based life insurance business looking for a highly skilled and motivated appointment setter to join our team.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply reads from a script.



We want a confident, persuasive, and professional communicator who knows how to build rapport, handle objections, and turn conversations into qualified appointments.



You will be contacting leads, identifying their interest in speaking with a licensed life insurance agent, and scheduling appointments.



**Your main goal is to book quality appointments that actually show up—not just fill the calendar.**



## Responsibilities



- Make outbound calls to leads who have provided appropriate permission to be contacted.

- Build genuine rapport and establish trust with potential clients.

- Professionally handle objections such as "I'm not interested," "I'm busy," or "Call me later."

- Qualify prospects using our approved questions.

- Schedule appointments with a licensed life insurance agent.

- Confirm appointments and send approved reminders.

- Update lead information and call outcomes in our CRM.

- Follow up with interested prospects in accordance with our contact policies.

- Maintain accurate daily calling and appointment reports.



## Requirements



- At least 2 years of outbound sales, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience.

- Previous experience with U.S. life insurance campaigns is strongly preferred.

- Experience with Final Expense, Mortgage Protection, Term Life, or similar campaigns is a major advantage.

- Excellent conversational English with clear pronunciation.

- Strong listening skills and natural confidence on the phone.

- Ability to handle rejection and objections professionally.

- Comfortable using CRM systems, dialers, and appointment scheduling software.

- Reliable internet connection, quiet working environment, and quality headset.

- Available during U.S. Pacific Time business hours.



## Compensation and Growth



- Starting compensation: $300–$500 USD per month, depending on experience and agreed hours.

- Paid trial period for selected candidates.

- Opportunity for increased hours, compensation reviews, and long-term career growth based on performance.

- Training, leads, approved scripts, and calling tools provided.



We value consistent performance, professionalism, integrity, and the ability to create a positive experience for potential customers.



This is an appointment-setting position. Insurance product advice, policy recommendations, applications, and closing insurance transactions are handled by licensed agents.



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions:



1. How many years of outbound calling and appointment-setting experience do you have?

2. Have you worked on U.S. life insurance campaigns? If yes, which ones?

3. Approximately how many calls did you make daily in your previous position?

4. How many qualified appointments did you typically book per day or week?

5. What was your average appointment show rate, if known?

6. How would you respond to a prospect who says, "I already have life insurance"?

7. What is your expected monthly salary for part-time work?



**IMPORTANT:** Please include a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your relevant sales experience.



Applications without a voice recording and answers to the questions may not be considered.



Qualified candidates will be invited to a paid live sales roleplay.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship with a growing U.S. insurance business.

title: Video Editor for You Tube Golf niche
description:
I enjoy editing my YouTube videos in Adobe Premiere, but I need to streamline my workflow and editing is a bottleneck for me.   I’d like an experienced editor who already has a good workflow and communication system so we don’t have to reinvent the wheel in developing a video production schedule and efficient process.   

My primary YouTube channel niche is Golf, and I’d like you to have a little bit of knowledge or interest in the game since you’ll be adding your creative thumbprint on my videos.    I have other very small channels that I’d like to have you edit for me if/when we get to that point, but for now, my primary focus will be Golf.

1. I’d like to see a few samples of your work

2. If we seem like a good match, I’m willing to pay you a nominal fee for a test edit on my footage, I’ll upload it to a Google drive?

3. Do you use Premier?  Frame.io?  Photoshop? 

4. Can you use the object mask tool or rotoscope in Premier if needed?

5. Can you use generative fill in Premier or Photoshop if needed?

6. Can you adjust audio in Premier?  Or what do you use?  Sometimes wind noise or other noise needs to be reduced or dialogue needs to be enhanced.

7. Can you adjust color in Premier if needed?  A lot of my footage is fine the way it is.

8. Do you have access to licensed B-roll and background music?  Which service?  It’s not required.

9. How do you handle copyright claims?

10. Can you edit a variety of video formats…. Talking head, walking and talking, golfing on course, voice overs?

11. How would you describe your style of editing?

12. How many years have you been editing for clients and do you have references from them?   How many years have you been editing YOUR OWN videos?

13. How do you charge for your services?  Per video? Per hour? Per minute of finished video?  Per month for so many videos?   What’s your preference?

14. How would you describe your usage of AI tools in your edits?  Give me an example and your preferred AI tools and how you use them?

15. I only publish to YouTube…. No tik tok, No instagram, No
.  Simple 😊

16. I mainly do long form and occasional short form vertical format.  Are you ok with that.  My videos are normally 8 to 15 minutes, but occasionally over that and maybe closer to 30 minutes.   

17. Can you do Thumbnails?  Do you want to do and LIKE to do thumbnails?

18. I would retain ownership of all my footage and all the work product that you produce for me.   Is that ok with you?

19. Do you have a written agreement with your creators or don’t really think it’s necessary?

20. Is video editing your full time job or do you have another job?  And what do you do? Just curious.

21. What’s your favorite thing about editing videos?  or your LEAST favorite thing about editing videos?

22. Describe your favorite client, past or present, and why did you like working for them?

23.  If I made a million dollars on the videos that you edited, how much of that do you think I should pay to you?

24. If I lost a million dollars making videos that you edited, how much of that do you think you should pay back to me?

25. What questions do you have for me?  Or anything you want me to know about you?



I know that’s a lot of questions !!  I hope it puts us a few steps closer to working with each other or mutually deciding we’re just not a good match for each other.   Either way, I appreciate you taking the time to consider working with me.

Thanks

Joe

PS:  I entered $300/month for salary because the form required an amount.... If you prefer to charge per edited video, we can discuss a rate per video?

title: Long & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing wellness brand rethinking the traditional protein bar — an all-natural, whole-food protein bar using clean, recognizable ingredients. As the brand expands across retail, our founders are documenting the behind-the-scenes journey of building the business — from travelling across the US and supporting retail launches to demos, events, and everyday startup life.



We're looking for a Long & Short-Form Video Editor to turn that raw footage into engaging, story-driven content. This role will primarily focus on editing long-form YouTube-style content, supported by short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the founders' personal social channels.



You'll receive raw footage from the founders and be responsible for turning it into polished, engaging content that captures the personality, energy, and reality of building a fast-growing consumer brand. We're looking for someone who is more than a technical editor — you should understand storytelling, pacing, humour, hooks, and retention, and be able to identify the moments within hours of footage that are actually worth watching.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities



1. Long-Form Video Editing



Edit raw founder footage into engaging YouTube-style episodes, typically around 15–25 minutes

Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, storylines, and narrative arcs

Turn loosely structured footage into cohesive, entertaining stories

Cut unnecessary material while maintaining natural pacing and personality

Add music, sound effects, text, graphics, subtitles, and other elements where appropriate

Handle basic colour correction, audio cleanup, and overall visual consistency

Create strong openings and hooks that encourage viewers to continue watching

Incorporate B-roll and supporting footage to strengthen storytelling

Manage revisions and deliver polished final edits on schedule

2. Short-Form Content



Turn long-form footage and standalone clips into TikToks, Instagram Reels, and other vertical content

Identify short moments that can work independently as compelling social content

Edit clips with strong hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-native formatting

Create content for both the brand and the founders' personal accounts

Develop teasers and cutdowns that help drive audiences toward longer YouTube content

Repurpose existing footage efficiently to maximise the value of each shoot

3. Content & Editing Workflow



Organise raw footage, project files, and completed assets in a clear and repeatable system

Maintain consistent editing styles, fonts, graphics, and visual treatments

Work closely with the founders to understand their preferred style and continuously refine it

Manage multiple videos at different stages of the editing process

Proactively suggest opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content

Stay current with editing styles and content trends across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years of professional video editing experience

Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both long-form and short-form editing; experience editing YouTube, documentary-style, vlog, founder-led, or behind-the-scenes content

Storytelling: Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention; ability to take several hours of raw footage and independently determine what should make the final cut

Short-Form: Excellent short-form editing instincts for TikTok and Instagram Reels

Technical: Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software; comfortable with captions, motion graphics, sound design, and basic colour correction

Organisation: Highly organised and able to manage large volumes of footage

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; able to work independently with limited direction

Bonus: Experience editing content for CPG, food, wellness, fitness, or lifestyle brands; experience editing founder-led YouTube series or startup/build-in-public content; basic motion graphics or After Effects experience; YouTube thumbnail design; familiarity with YouTube retention analytics; experience repurposing long-form content into multiple short-form assets



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: 🚨 NOW HIRING: EXPERIENCED CREDIT REPAIR DISPUTE SPECIALIST VA
description:
Remote Position | Long-Term Opportunity | Experienced Professionals ONLY



We are looking for a highly experienced, results-driven Credit Repair Dispute Specialist Virtual Assistant to join our growing team long-term.



⚠️ IMPORTANT: WE ARE ONLY LOOKING FOR EXPERIENCED DISPUTERS WHO HAVE PROVEN KNOWLEDGE OF ADVANCED DISPUTE STRATEGIES, EXPEDITED TECHNIQUES, AND A TRACK RECORD OF PRODUCING FAST RESULTS.



We are NOT looking for beginners or individuals who only know how to generate basic dispute letters and wait 30–45 days for responses.



We want someone who understands advanced credit repair, knows multiple legitimate dispute methods, and has hands-on experience obtaining expedited deletions and corrections.



🔥 FAST DELETIONS & ADVANCED DISPUTING EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have experience disputing and successfully resolving inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable information involving:



* Collections

* Charge-offs

* Bankruptcies

* Repossessions

* Foreclosures

* Late payments

* Student loans

* Medical collections

* Hard inquiries

* Judgments and public records

* Closed derogatory accounts

* Other negative credit reporting items



WE ARE ESPECIALLY INTERESTED IN SPECIALISTS WHO HAVE ACHIEVED LEGITIMATE DELETIONS WITHIN 7–30 DAYS.



You should understand how to identify opportunities for expedited results, use appropriate escalation methods, analyze reporting inconsistencies, and develop strategies beyond standard dispute letters.



We understand that not every negative account qualifies for removal and that results cannot be guaranteed. However, we expect applicants to have proven experience identifying legitimate opportunities to obtain faster results.



If you only know how to send generic dispute letters, this position is NOT for you.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Review and analyze complete 3-bureau credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

* Identify inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, inconsistent, or unverifiable reporting.

* Develop customized dispute strategies based on each client’s credit profile.

* Utilize advanced, legally compliant dispute techniques and expedited escalation procedures when appropriate.

* Prepare and submit disputes to credit bureaus and furnishers.

* Handle complicated collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, repossessions, and other derogatory accounts.

* Identify reporting violations, inconsistencies, and legitimate opportunities for faster resolutions.

* Manage multiple clients and dispute rounds simultaneously.

* Track dispute deadlines, bureau responses, deletions, updates, and investigation results.

* Review all results before determining the next dispute strategy.

* Escalate complicated files and unresolved reporting issues when necessary.

* Maintain detailed client notes, dispute histories, and documentation.

* Upload dispute letters, results, and supporting documents into DisputeFox.

* Communicate regularly with customer service, management, and other departments through Slack.

* Use GoHighLevel to manage client information, tasks, pipeline stages, follow-ups, and workflows.

* Properly complete client and task handoffs between departments.

* Keep DisputeFox, Slack, and GoHighLevel updated so the entire team knows where each client stands.

* Follow company SOPs, compliance procedures, and confidentiality requirements.



ADVANCED DISPUTE EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We strongly prefer applicants with hands-on experience in the following areas:



Credit Repair & Dispute Strategies



* Traditional bureau disputes

* Direct furnisher disputes

* Advanced credit report analysis

* FCRA Sections 609, 611, and 623

* FCRA Section 605B for legitimate identity-theft cases

* Metro 2 reporting accuracy analysis

* Method-of-verification requests

* Reinsertion disputes

* CFPB complaints and escalations

* BBB complaints

* FTC identity-theft reports when legitimately applicable

* LexisNexis disputes

* ChexSystems disputes

* Early Warning Services disputes

* Complex bankruptcy disputes

* Collection and charge-off reporting disputes

* Repossession reporting disputes

* Expedited resolution opportunities

* Advanced escalation procedures

* Investigation of inaccurate furnisher reporting



Software & Team Management



* DisputeFox

* Slack

* GoHighLevel (GHL)

* LetterStream

* Credit monitoring and 3-bureau report analysis platforms

* CRM management

* Client pipeline management

* Workflow automation

* Task assignments and departmental handoffs

* Dispute tracking and reporting



We are looking for someone who understands WHY a dispute strategy works, WHEN to use it, and HOW to execute it effectively.



The more advanced legitimate credit repair techniques, systems, and strategies you bring to the table, the better.



REQUIREMENTS



* Previous professional credit repair/disputing experience is required.

* Proven experience handling collections, charge-offs, bankruptcies, and other complicated derogatory accounts.

* Strong understanding of advanced dispute methods and expedited resolution opportunities.

* Demonstrated history of obtaining legitimate deletions and corrections.

* Ability to explain previous dispute strategies and results.

* DisputeFox experience is a BIG PLUS.

* Experience working with Slack and GoHighLevel is strongly preferred.

* Ability to manage a high volume of active client files.

* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Strong written English and professional communication.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple dispute rounds.

* Ability to communicate effectively with multiple departments.

* Comfortable following SOPs, workflows, and compliance requirements.

* Ability to maintain accurate documentation and client records.

* Strict confidentiality when handling sensitive client information.

* Dependable, accountable, and committed to long-term growth.



⚠️ WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Please DO NOT apply if:



* You are a beginner with little or no credit repair experience.

* You only know how to generate basic dispute letters.

* You have no experience with advanced dispute strategies.

* You cannot explain your expedited dispute techniques.

* You have never successfully handled complicated derogatory accounts.

* You cannot demonstrate or explain previous results.

* You struggle with managing multiple clients and deadlines.

* You are unfamiliar with organized remote team communication.

* You do not consistently update client files and CRM systems.

* You are looking for a temporary position instead of long-term employment.

* You rely on fabricated identity-theft claims, false documentation, or unlawful dispute practices.

title: Strict Fitness Accountability Referee – 13 weeks, ~15 min/day
description:
PAY: $175 USD/month flat, paid monthly in advance. Oct 13, 2026 – Jan 8, 2027 (13 weeks). About 15 minutes a day.



I'm preparing for my wedding and I've put money on the line in a stickK commitment contract. If I miss my weekly targets, I lose $100. I need a STRICT, NEUTRAL referee who does not know me to check my proof every day and decide pass/fail every week.



This is not a motivation job. It's a verification job. I'm not paying you to be nice to me. I'm paying you to follow written rules with zero exceptions. Your pay is the same whether I pass or fail.



WHAT YOU DO

- Every day (~10 min): I send proof on WhatsApp before midnight (Dubai time, GMT+4). You check it against the checklist and log it in a shared Google Sheet.

- Every Monday (~20 min): You review the week, then click Successful or Unsuccessful on 
 (free account, I'll send the invite).



THE RULES YOU ENFORCE (all must be met to PASS the week)

1. Steps: 10,000+ steps on ALL 7 days, shown in an iPhone Health "Show All Data" screenshot. 9,999 is a fail.

2. Training: 4 workouts per week that follow my written plan (Upper A, Lower A, Upper B, Lower B, abs included). Proof: a workout log showing every exercise and set, plus a gym photo with the time showing. A missed workout can only be made up within the same Mon–Sun week.

3. Nutrition: Carbs 200g, Protein 165g, Fat 65g, each within ±10% (C 180–220, P 149–182, F 59–72), on 6 of 7 days. Proof: daily MyFitnessPal totals screenshot. I get one day off per week, but only if I tell you THAT MORNING. Announcing it afterwards does not count.

4. Weekly report: Sent by Sunday 9pm. Weight, waist, front/side/back photos, plus a printed InBody scan every 2nd week.



FINAL OUTCOME CHECK (separate, one-time)

In the first week of January I do a final InBody scan, under the same conditions as my starting scan. I send you the printed report AND a video of me standing on the machine until the result prints. PASS only if body fat is 11.5% or lower AND skeletal muscle mass is 43.0 kg or higher. 11.6% or 42.9 kg = FAIL. Not sent by January 6 = FAIL.



NON-NEGOTIABLE INSTRUCTIONS

- Missing proof = FAIL. Late proof = FAIL. Blurry or unreadable proof = FAIL.

- "My phone died," "I forgot to log it," "I was traveling" = FAIL.

- If I ask you for leniency, a pass, or an exception, that alone = FAIL for that week.

- The only exception: illness, with a doctor's note sent the same day.

- When in doubt, FAIL. I'd rather lose $100 than be let off.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

- Detail-oriented, reliable, responds daily, comfortable saying no

- Fitness or nutrition background is a plus (certified coach preferred), but not required

- Has WhatsApp and Google Sheets

- Available for the full 13 weeks



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "NO EXCEPTIONS" so I know you read this far. Then answer:

1. On Wednesday my screenshot shows 9,870 steps. I tell you my phone died during an evening walk and I definitely did 10k. Pass or fail for the week? Why?

2. My protein for one day is 147g, and I hadn't announced a day off. What do you do?

3. Your experience with fitness, nutrition, or accountability work (2–3 sentences).

title: GOHIGHLEVEL BUILDER & POSSIBLE FUTURE MANAGER (Multiple Openings)
description:
I run marketing systems on GoHighLevel. I write the specs. What I need are the people who build them - accurately, cleanly, and without needing to be chased.



This is not an architect role and it is not a client-facing role to start. You will be handed a clear spec and you will build it.



I am hiring multiple people for this position. Beyond just building, there is a clear upward path: the builder who proves the best understanding of the platform and demonstrates strong communication and people skills will step into a possible future manager position. As the manager, you will transition from hourly pay to a steady salary.



Every build gets reviewed by your future GM (who will handle onboarding, client communication, and team management) before it ships. You will get direct feedback and you will get better at this. If you want to build inside GoHighLevel all day with someone experienced checking your work, and want a shot at leading the team, this is a good seat.



==============================

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

SNAPSHOTS & WORKFLOWS



Sub-account snapshots from my template - pipelines, custom values, calendars, the full shell



Automation workflows to spec: multi-step, with wait steps, conditions, and goal events



Trigger links, opportunity stage automation, appointment reminders



FUNNELS, SITES & FORMS



Funnels, landing pages, order forms, surveys, calendars



Built from my wireframes and copy - clean, mobile-checked, reusable



DAY-TO-DAY BUILD WORK



Cloning and customizing snapshots across sub-accounts



Wiring up the integrations I hand you:

 lead ads, website forms, call tracking



Migrating and cleaning contacts - dedupe, tag by source



Running the full end-to-end test before you hand anything in: submit a test lead, confirm the text-back fires to a real phone, confirm the
 lands in the inbox and not spam, confirm the calendar books. Screenshot each step.



A short Loom on what you built and anything you were unsure about



NICE TO HAVE (not required)



Zapier or Make experience using existing recipes



GoHighLevel's built-in Conversation AI, set up following my prompts



I am NOT asking for custom code, API development, or AI agent design. I handle that side.



==============================

YOU MUST HAVE

Real hands-on time inside GoHighLevel - sub-accounts, workflows, calendars, pipelines. Not "I've watched the tutorials."



The ability to open a broken workflow and explain why it isn't firing



Genuine attention to detail - you follow the SOP exactly, and you tell me when the SOP is wrong



Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and comfort with time tracking (Timeproof)



At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Central time



==============================

HOW I WORK

Project-based to start. I hand you a spec, you build it, your future GM reviews it, you ship. Clear scopes. No scope creep.



There is a ladder:



BUILDS 1-3 - Initial trial builds and rate review based on proven delivery.

ONGOING - Steady build volume and first pick of the work.

THE MANAGEMENT SEAT - The top builder with the best platform mastery and strong people/communication skills steps up into a full-time management position on a salary instead of hourly pay.



I am hiring multiple people. The ones who prove out get the volume; the standout leader gets the management seat.



==============================

WHAT I PAY

$5-$10/hour to start, based on what you can actually build.

Rate reviewed after every 3 completed builds.

Management position: Full-time salary (transitioning off hourly pay).



The rate moves with your accuracy. The less your reviewer has to correct, the faster you climb.



==============================

DO NOT APPLY IF

Your GoHighLevel experience is "I watched the tutorials"



You cannot explain what a custom value is and why it matters



You need to be reminded to test your own build



You are juggling 4 agencies and this would be filler work



You go quiet for days without sending a message



I would rather see 5 real applications than 300 copy-paste ones.



==============================

HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with: BUILD-[the name of one real GHL workflow trigger you have actually used]



Example format: BUILD-CustomerBookedAppointment

Applications without this are deleted unread.



In 4 sentences or fewer, tell me the most complex thing you have built inside GoHighLevel - and what broke while you were building it.



Link one Loom (3 minutes max) walking me through any real build you have done in GoHighLevel - even a simple one. Screen share the actual account. Tell me why you built it that way. I am not judging your video quality. I am judging whether you understand what you built.



No cover letters. No portfolios of logos. No "I am hardworking and fast learner." Show me the work.

title: Client Response & Outreach Coordinator
description:
$8.75 per hour. 15 hours per week guaranteed, up to 20 as required.



About us



Ready2Exit is Australia's #1 business marketplace. We help business owners sell the companies they have spent twenty or thirty years building, and we help buyers acquire them properly. Most of the people we deal with are owner operators in trades, manufacturing and services, and for almost all of them, selling their business is the largest financial decision they will ever make.



I am Stuart Earl, Investor, M&A Advisor and leader of Australia's #1 business marketplace, with over 180,000 members.



We are a lean team, so you will work directly with me every day. What you do will show up directly in whether this business grows, and you will be able to watch that happen rather than take my word for it.



What we care about



Most business owners only sell a business once in their life. The industry does not serve them well, and the complaints are always the same: overpromising, no transparency, and no real buyer engagement. We built Ready2Exit to fix that, through preparation, honesty and doing the work properly.



Three things matter here more than anything else, and they will shape your day.



The first is speed. When a business owner calls us back, they are d
 in that moment whether we are serious people. A response forty five minutes later answers that question for them, and not in our favour.



The second is precision. Details carry real weight here. A wrong figure in a follow up email can cost us a mandate that took months to win.



The third is honesty, and that includes honesty upwards. If I have made a mistake, I would rather hear it from you on the day than find it myself a fortnight later. The same applies in the other direction, and I will tell you directly when something is not right. Most people prefer working that way once they get used to it.



The role



You will own the front line of our communication, in both directions.



On one side, we run outreach campaigns and paid advertising that generate inbound calls, replies and form submissions. Those currently sit too long before anyone answers them, and it is the single biggest gap in our week. Closing that gap is the main reason this role exists.



On the other side, when we take on a business to sell, we build a list of buyers who might be a fit and we call them. This is warm work. You are ringing people who are actively looking to buy a business and telling them we have something worth a look.



Either way, you are the first person from Ready2Exit that a buyer or a business owner ever speaks to. You are the first voice of the business, and I treat that as one of the most important seats we have.



What you will be responsible for



The list below is in priority order, and the order genuinely matters. When two things compete, the one higher up wins. You will never need to ask my permission to drop something for an inbound call.



Inbound response. Every call, reply and form submission that comes from our campaigns. Qualify it against criteria I will give you, then book it, route it or close it out. Log every single one. You own that contact from the first touch through to a booked appointment.



Outbound buyer outreach. When we have a business on the market, you will work through a buyer list by phone and email, introduce the opportunity, and book the ones who are interested.



Callbacks and appointment booking. Returning missed calls and managing my diary around them.



Follow up. Post pitch follow up by email and phone, on a cadence that you own and run without me reminding you, plus a weekly sweep of the pipeline for anything that has gone quiet.



Scheduling and rescheduling. Multi party, across time zones, with nothing dropped.



Administration. Onboarding emails and forms, and setting up document folders and permissions for live deals.



A good part of this role runs through our CRM, GoHighLevel. Experience with it is a real plus, though not a dealbreaker. If you are sharp and organised, it is quick to learn, and I will train you on it.



The standard



We are a high performance team and we thrive on overdelivering for our clients.



Fifteen minutes is the response time inside your window. We will measure it, and it will be your key measure of success.



Some mornings a campaign goes out and inbound will take your entire window. Other mornings it will be quiet and you will work through the background list. Both of those are normal and neither is a problem.



Outside your window we are honestly uncovered. Automation acknowledges people and you call them at the start of the next morning. We keep it honest about the size of our team.



Who I am looking for



You have worked somewhere the phone was the revenue. That might be a medical or dental front desk, service dispatch, roadside assistance, insurance claims intake, hotel reservations, client services at a broking firm, or an inbound queue with a target on the wall. What matters is that you have done this under a clock rather than at your own pace.



You will know the specific feeling of being halfway through careful work when something urgent lands. You can deal with the urgent thing, log it properly before you move on, and then go back and finish the careful work without breaking it. Most people manage two of those three. If you can do all three reliably, you are the person I want to talk to.



You will be speaking with Australian business owners, often people who have run their company for decades and do not suffer waffle. You need to be clear, warm and quick on your feet on the phone, able to hold a real conversation and sound like someone worth their time. If you are more comfortable behind email than on a call, this will not suit you. Your written English matters too, because your emails go out under my name into live deals, so they need to read as if I wrote them.



You should get a kick out of a fast moving environment where things change without much warning. Some mornings the plan lasts ten minutes before a campaign lands or a deal moves. If that reads as chaos to you, this will not suit. If it reads as a good morning, we should talk. The people who do well here are comfortable in the unknown and would rather work something out than wait to be told.



Beyond that, I am looking for someone who catches the error nobody flagged, but who also knows when good enough is good enough and the deadline wins. Someone who can be given an outcome rather than a method and work the rest out. Someone who does not need me standing behind them. And someone with mature confidence, by which I mean you will tell me when you think I am wrong, once, with your reasoning, and then get on with the decision either way.



What you get



The rate is $8.75 per hour, with 15 hours guaranteed and up to 20 hours in weeks where the volume requires it, at the same rate.



On growth, I will be straight with you. Our volume is increasing and my intention is to take this role to 30 hours or more within three months. That happens when the workload supports it and when you have shown you can hold the standard. If both of those are true, the hours are there and the path to full time is real.



You will work directly with me, with no layers in between. You will get proper training, and you will learn how business acquisitions actually work, which is exposure that very few people in this market ever get. You will also be trusted with confidential financial information and live deals from early on, because I need this seat close to the real work.



Nice to have, though not required



SharePoint or OneDrive, exposure to Australian clients, or a background in professional services or finance.



How to apply



Please read this section properly. A large number of applications will be set aside for missing a step, and that is deliberate.



Begin your application with the word DISPATCH.

Complete the short application form here: 



It takes about five minutes and it is how I shortlist, so take a little care with it.



That is the whole first step. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short video and a conversation with me after that, so there is nothing to record right now.



I read every completed application and I reply to all of them, including the ones I am not taking forward.



Stuart Earl

Founder, Ready2Exit | Australia's #1 business marketplace

Who I am looking for



Traits first, because I can teach the tools and I cannot teach these.



You finish things. An unfinished job genuinely bothers you.



You stay organised when the plan changes. When I reprioritise mid week, you park what you were doing cleanly, pick up the new thing, and come back to the first later without it slipping through a crack. You run a system for that. It is not luck.

Your written English is strong enough that I can send your client emails and newsletter drafts with little or no change

You can set up folders and permissions in SharePoint or OneDrive

You understand enough about business to feed our processes good information, and to notice when something we produce does not look right



What you get



$8.75 per hour to start, with room to grow for the right experience and demonstrated GHL competency. 



Part time to begin with, growing as our volume grows



Direct access to me, with nobody in between

A role that is genuinely yours to own, with a founder who gives you the outcome and lets you work out the how



Nice to have



GoHighLevel specifically, rather than a comparable platform

Experience in a marketing agency or a client delivery team

Any exposure to M&A, finance, or professional services

Canva or PowerPoint for putting documents together



How to apply



I have kept this simple. Complete the short application form here: 



So I know you read to the end, begin your message to me on OnlineJobs with the word ATTENTION.



Stuart Earl

M&A Advisor | Founder, Ready2Exit

Australia's leading SMB M&A Advisory Firm

title: STR Virtual Assistant
description:
JOB TITLE

Virtual Assistant, Short-Term Rental Operations



Part time, remote. Full hour coverage, but work is sporadic as needed. 8 hour shifts per day, morning or afternoon shift. Reports to: the founder.



SUMMARY

You'll be the coordination hub and the guest-facing voice for our growing portfolio. Day to day, you keep cleaners and vendors scheduled, confirmed and work verified, answer guests with speed and warmth, catch problems early, and send a daily summary so the founder never has to chase status. You'll also help standardize operations with SOPs and new and improved automations.



ABOUT US

At Chill & Thrill Retreats Management, a stay is never just a stay. We create immersive, experience-driven retreats like our Nautical, Forest, Beach and Stargazing Retreats, each professionally designed to be our guests' vacation, not just a place to sleep. The destination is the bonus. Our stays are designed to provide our guests a place to build memories that last for years to come!



We're owner-operated and powered by smart systems and automation, with 5 live properties, all in the top 1%, and 2 more coming. We sweat the details so every guest gets the WOW from the first message to after checkout. If you love hospitality, love a good system, and want to help build something with meaning, you'll fit right in!



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Guest Communications & Reservation Management

- Be the voice of Chill & Thrill Retreats Management: respond promptly and warmly to guests through our property management system (PMS) and booking channels, Airbnb and VRBO.

- Monitor the inbox and alerts in our property management system, send and refine templated messages, and step in when automated responses need correction.

- Support guests from booking inquiry through check-in, access issues, amenity questions and checkout.

- Review reservation details and special requests, and prepare the home for each guest (like pool heating) before arrival.

- Resolve routine concerns within approval limits, and escalate urgent, sensitive or high-cost issues with a clear summary and recommended next steps.



Cleaning, Maintenance, & Vendor Coordination

- Maintain the calendar for turnovers, cleanings, hot tubs, maintenance and other vendor work.

- Confirm all tasks are scheduled and accepted.

- Communicate with handymen and vendors as needed to maintain the houses, and source new contractors if needed.

- Verify the work has been completed by reviewing pictures of cleans and work completion, and follow up if not to our standards.

- Follow up with cleaners on supplies and reported issues.



Administrative

- Keep boards, task trackers, property info, guest records and vendor contacts current in monday.com and Breezeway.

- Check listing accuracy across channels, flag pricing anomalies, and monitor alerts and guest feedback, following up as needed.

- Assist with guest reviews, damage claims, disputes, and platform support cases by gathering documentation and following up.

- Send an end-of-shift update plus daily and weekly summaries covering completed tasks, open issues, pending approvals and decisions needed.

- Write SOPs for repeat tasks, flag recurring problems, and help build simple automations in tools like Zapier.



Note: All assigned work must be completed personally. Delegating or outsourcing work to sub-VAs or other individuals is not permitted.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- STR operations run smoothly and predictably.

- Cleans are coordinated and completed without issues.

- Vendors are coordinated and scheduled, and their work is completed seamlessly.

- Problems are caught early and resolved quickly.

- SOPs are created, and automations are added or improved.

- The daily summary lands on time and the founder stops chasing status.



WHO YOU ARE

- 2+ years as a VA, customer support, or operations coordinator in short-term rentals, hospitality or property management.

- Excellent written and spoken English with a warm, professional tone, comfortable talking with vendors and cleaners.

- Dependable internet and power backup, a headset, and a quiet workspace for calls with vendors and cleaners.

- Experience with key software tools: Hospitable PMS, Airbnb, VRBO, monday.com. Breezeway is a plus.

- Detail-obsessed: you catch the wrong date, the missing code or the double booking before it becomes a problem.

- Takes initiative: tell us what you'll do, not just what's wrong.



WHY THIS ROLE

- Steady, long-term work. Will be full-time shortly.

- Clear expectations and a manager who responds.

- Room to grow into a senior operations role as we add properties.



TO APPLY

Send your resume, a 60-second Loom or video intro, and a short note answering: "A guest messages at 11pm saying the door code isn't working. Walk us through what you do."

Responsibilities

Add suitable background music and sound effects.

Maintain engaging pacing throughout each video.

Export finished videos in the required YouTube format.



YouTube Shorts



Create vertical Shorts using supplied material and/or footage from the long-form videos.

Select engaging moments and create strong opening hooks.

Add captions, music, and sound effects where appropriate.

Format videos in 9:16 vertical format for YouTube Shorts.



Monthly Content Plan

15 long-form videos per month, subject to the agreed video length and complexity.

YouTube Shorts included as part of the monthly package, with the exact quantity agreed upon before hiring.



Scripts and voiceovers will be provided. The editor will handle footage sourcing and editing.



Requirements

Ability to follow scripts and creative references.

Basic understanding of storytelling and audience retention.

Ability to find relevant footage and supporting visuals.

Good sense of pacing, music, and sound design.

Reliable communication and time management.

Ability to meet deadlines consistently.

Willingness to accept feedback and improve over time.



Preferred software: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing tools.



Experience with faceless YouTube channels is an advantage but not required.



Compensation



The fixed starting budget is $200 USD per month for the agreed monthly deliverables.



The exact number of Shorts, video lengths, editing complexity, and turnaround times will be finalized before the monthly arrangement begins.



This is intended to be an ongoing working relationship. Additional deliverables or more complex editing requests will be discussed separately.



A paid test edit will be offered to shortlisted applicants before the monthly arrangement is finalized.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



Links to 2–3 videos you have personally edited.

Your experience with faceless YouTube channels.

The editing software you use.

Confirmation that you can source footage and music.

Your typical turnaround time for long-form videos and Shorts.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Marketing Lead (Full-Time, Remote) – Solar & Battery Company, Melbourne, Australia

You'll be the marketing expert. We'll be the solar experts.

Elecsol Electrical is a growing solar, battery and electrical business in Melbourne, Australia. We're very good at the electrical side. Marketing is where we need help, and we're looking for someone who knows it better than we do.

This isn't a role where you'll be told what to do every day. We want you to ask us what we're after, then come back with the best plan, or a few options, for getting us more of the right work.

About the role

You'll lead our marketing. You'll have a team member working under you as your 2IC, and you'll report directly to the owner. He'll handle the electrical side ("is this photo right?", "can we say this?"). Everything else about how we market is your call.

What success looks like

• First 2 weeks: You've asked the questions you need, given us a written plan, and have campaigns running.

• First 6 weeks: Your work is bringing in at least one extra booked job per week.

• Longer term: We're booked a week in advance with well-qualified solar and battery jobs.

Right now our leads aren't qualified well enough. Better leads matter more to us than more leads.

What you'll do

• Learn our business by asking the owner and sales team the right questions

• Build and run our lead generation (Facebook, Google and any other channel you can show will work)

• Lead and manage your 2IC: set priorities, check their work, help them improve

• Track leads from first contact to booked job, and show us what's working and what isn't

• Fix problems in your area without waiting for permission. If it costs money, come to us with the cost and your options, not just the problem

• Tell us how often you think we should catch up, and run those catch-ups

What we're looking for

Required:

• 3+ years in marketing with lead generation as a main part of your job

• Proof of results: campaigns you've run and the numbers they produced

• Experience running paid ads on Facebook/Meta and/or Google

• Experience managing or directing at least one person

• Strong written and spoken English

• Quick, reliable communication during work hours

Nice to have:

• Experience in solar, energy, trades or home services

• Experience marketing for an Australian business

• Experience using a CRM

Hours

Full-time (8 hours/day, Monday–Friday). Hours are flexible, but you must be online and available between 1:00pm and 8:00pm Melbourne time (currently 10:00am–5:00pm Philippine time). Reliable internet and a quiet workspace required.

Pay and trial

• Starting at AUD $10–12/hour, moving to $15/hour once you hit agreed targets

• Bonuses for booked jobs that come from your work

• Your marketing budget starts small and grows as you show results

• First performance review at 1 month

How we work

We're a small, practical team. Our values are simple: common sense, take accountability, find a solution. You'll get direct access to the owner and room to make real decisions. If you'd rather be told exactly what to do, this isn't for you. If you'd rather figure it out and show us what you've done, it is.

How to apply

Send your resume, examples of results you've achieved, and a short answer (one page max) to this question:

"You've just started as head of marketing at a solar and battery company in Melbourne. What are the first 10 questions you'd ask the owner, and why?"

Applications without an answer won't be considered.

title: Overnight Track & Trace Coordinator, US Freight Brokerage
description:
Graveyard Desk provides overnight operations coverage for small US freight brokerages. We're hiring a Track & Trace Coordinator to work a defined overnight window for our brokerage clients.



SCHEDULE

7pm–3am US Central, Monday–Friday. That's daytime in the Philippines: 8am–4pm PH time now, 9am–5pm PH time after US daylight saving ends in November.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make scheduled check calls to drivers on active loads and log location and ETA

- Track loads in the client's TMS and tracking tools and keep statuses current

REQUIREMENTS

- 1+ year of US freight brokerage, 3PL, or track & trace experience (required)

- Familiarity with a TMS (e.g., McLeod, Aljex, Tai, Revenova, Ascend) is a plus

- Spanish or Punjabi is a bonus



HIRING PROCESS

1. Short application (see below)

2. Voice recording review

3. Live role-play call with a "driver" scenario

4. Paid trial shift



START DATE

We're building our candidate shortlist now. The role starts when our next client onboards, expected within the coming weeks. We'll keep every shortlisted candidate updated.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word REEFER so we know you read this post. Include:

- Your freight / track & trace experience (company type, how long, what you handled)

- The TMS and tracking tools you've used

- A 1–2 minute voice recording: introduce yourself and describe a load problem you handled

title: SEO Specialist | Writer
description:
ABOUT US

Dasho Partners is a family-owned home improvement company in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA. We have been in business since 2002, we have 40+ team members, and we won the 2024 Better Business Bureau Torch Award for Ethics. We install roofing, siding, windows, doors, gutters and insulation for homeowners in northwest Wisconsin.



You'll work alongside an experienced SEO Manager who has been with our company for several years. This role works alongside him. We are looking for someone who wants a long-term home, not a short project.



THE ROLE

You will own the day-to-day execution of our SEO and content program. Our Marketing Director and SEO Manager set the strategy — which keywords, which topics, which cities. You do the work that makes it happen.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- 3+ years hands-on SEO experience, including technical SEO — not just content writing, and not just keyword research

- Excellent written English. You will be writing for American homeowners. Your writing must sound natural to them, not translated and not obviously AI-generated

- Experience with Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, and at least one crawler (Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, Ahrefs, Semrush or similar)

- Comfortable working inside a CMS and publishing live pages carefully

- Detail-oriented and honest about your work. We verify everything, and we would much rather you tell us something went wrong than hide it

- Reliable internet and your own computer

- Hours are flexible, preferred hours are Tuesday through Saturday 8am EST to 5pm EST



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE

- USD $700 – $1,000/month depending on experience

- Paid weekly, deposited every Friday via Wise

- 40 hours/week, Tuesday through Saturday, 8am EST to 5pm EST

- 40 hours of personal time off per year

- Independent contractor arrangement — you are responsible for your own taxes and contributions

- Annual review and renewal every March 25th





HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application. We read every one, and generic applications are the fastest way to get skipped.



In your message, answer these four things:

1. Send links to 2 pieces of content you personally wrote that rank. Tell us the keyword and roughly where it ranks.

2. Describe one technical SEO problem you found and fixed. What was broken, how did you find it, what did you do?

3. What tools do you use for SEO work, and how do you use AI in your writing process? Be specific and be honest.

4. What time of day are you usually available in US Eastern time?

5. If any, give screenshots of your past technical SEO experience and what you did during that time.



Our Hiring Process



1. Initial Review & Recruiter Conversation

We’ll start with a conversation to learn more about your background, experience, and goals while also reviewing the details of the role and what success looks like in this position.



2. Technical Interview & Paid Work Sample

The next step is a technical interview with our SEO team. This stage includes a paid work sample using a real-world task related to the role. You will be compensated for your time, allowing you to experience how we work while giving us the opportunity to evaluate your approach and quality of work.



3. Final Interview & Culture Fit

The final stage is a conversation with our Marketing Director to discuss team fit, communication style, and how you would align with our company.



4. Offer

If selected, we will move forward with an offer to join our team.



We believe in respecting candidates’ time and experience. Any work sample completed during our hiring process is paid — we do not ask candidates to perform unpaid work.

The practice is run by a certified psychotherapist with over twenty years of experience. She runs group programmes that help people with the patterns that keep getting in the way of their relationships.



We are taking her programme online with an application funnel:

Meta ads ‚Üí webinar registration ‚Üí live webinar ‚Üí application ‚Üí one to one call with the founder ‚Üí purchase



Morten Hake leads the strategy and writes the copy. You own everything technical: you build it, launch it, run the ads and keep it working. Later we add social media and SEO.



This is not a fixed list of pages. We test, we learn, and when a new idea makes sense, it gets built. The work grows with the business.

- Landing pages, registration and thank you pages, recording page, application page and form, sales page, purchase confirmation

-
 sequences, workflows and automations, pipelines, calendar booking for the founder's calls

Payments

s



Meta Ads

- Pixel and Conversions API, with a separate event for qualified applications

- Uploading creatives, testing, reading the numbers and reporting what works



Setup and growth

- Domain, DNS and
 authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)

- Google Search Console and the basics of SEO

- Editing short vertical videos and scheduling posts



HOW YOU WORK



- You use AI every day. Claude Code, Codex or similar, to build pages and sections faster and better than the standard GoHighLevel editor allows.

- You think for yourself. You get a brief, you understand what it's for, and you find the best way to build it. If something won't work as written, you say so before you build it, and suggest what will.

- Your deadlines hold. When we agree a date, it's done by that date. If something threatens it, we hear it from you before the date, not after.

- You test before anything goes live. The whole journey, on mobile, as a real lead would experience it.

- Close at first, then on your own. In the first weeks we work closely together while you get to know the project. After that you run it yourself, with a short update at the end of each working day: what's done, what's next, what you're waiting for.



WHAT MATTERS MOST



We weigh mindset and effort above everything else. Anything technical can be learned, and you will get mentoring along the way. If we work well together and the attitude is right, it doesn't matter that you can't tick every box below. Apply anyway.



Must have

 deliverability

- Logins are never shared, and no one else works on the practice's accounts without written approval. That includes assistants and subcontractors.

HOW TO APPLY
