title: Video Editor for Ecommerce - Facebook Ads
description:
Company Overview:



At ACTIV, we are a forward-thinking ecommerce marketing agency dedicated to revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our mission is to craft compelling marketing campaigns that not only captivate but also convert. Our brands are some of the fastest growing brands in the DTC space that are in the health and wellness space. With creativity at our core, we strive to push the boundaries of ecommerce marketing, making an indelible impact on the industry.



Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Video Editor to join our dynamic team for a full time role. This individual will play a crucial role in post-production video editing, creating engaging and effective video assets that resonate with our target audiences and drive purchases for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate will have a blend of creative talent, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of ecommerce marketing.



Qualifications:

At least 2 years of experience in video editing within the ecommerce marketing space, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.

Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and Davinci.

Solid understanding of key metrics like hook rate, hold rate, and click through rate, and expertise in creating short-form direct response videos.

A background in creative strategy is highly advantageous.

Agency experience is a plus

Experience using AI tools like Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, and others

BONUS: If you can create your own videos based on the brand data (winners, angles, content that’s working) - we pay out bonuses for this type of work

Fluency in English is required.





Key Competencies:

Strong creative and direct response skills, with the ability to produce content that engages and converts.

Experience taking briefs from a creative strategist and developing high-quality video assets.

A desire to continually learn, grow, and challenge the status quo in video editing and content creation.

Ability to utilize AI tools in the editing process as well as learning new AI tools to expedite the ability to create more winning creative.

Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling video content.

A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new video concepts for our advertising campaigns.

You need to be a self-starter. You will be given the creative freedom to create winning assets and data from the brands you work on.





Overview:

As part of the ACTIV agency, you play a crucial role in shaping the visual storytelling and narrative of our ecommerce clients. Your expertise in video editing will be instrumental in creating compelling content that not only reflects the essence of each brand but also drives new customer acquisition at scale. Given the remote nature of your role, we value independence, communication, and the ability to manage time effectively across different time zones.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Video Editing: You will be responsible for editing raw footage into polished content for Meta & TikTok. This involves cutting hooks effectively, creating a cohesive story through the video content, and making the video engaging and effective to drive higher thumb stop rates (staying past the first 3 seconds), longer hold times (watching for at least 15 seconds), and high click through rates.



Collaboration: Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and other editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Communication will primarily be via digital platforms, including Slack, and once a week video calls via Slack.

Creative Input: Contribute ideas and suggestions to improve content quality during brainstorming sessions and creative meetings. Your input on the creative direction, storytelling elements, and visual style is highly valued.

Project Management: Manage your video editing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring that all content is completed within the agreed timelines and adheres to the client's brand guidelines. This includes prioritizing tasks, setting milestones, and keeping stakeholders informed of progress.

Quality Control: Ensure all videos meet ACTIV’s quality standards and are optimized for viewing on Meta & TikTok.

Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of video editing software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team.



Working Hours:

This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone.



Expectations:

Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report.

Deliver high-quality video content within specified deadlines.

Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines.



Tools and Software:

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and other relevant video editing software is expected.



Compensation:

The Video Editor role is a dynamic position with the opportunity to significantly impact the success of our e-commerce clients through compelling video content. Recognizing the importance of this role, we offer competitive compensation packages for a full time role:

Compensation: 

Compensation is dependent on location of hire and competitive pay for the region the video editor is in. You will be asked your expected range of pay in your job application.

Note: Though output will be measured and managed, quality is essential. This is why we created a bonus structure that supports higher quality content that can scale spend behind it, versus creating a lot of content that may not scale spend behind it.



Expectations and Growth:

This role will be a full time role with expectations that we will provide you with the resources to succeed. This growth path is supported by a clear compensation and bonus structure that rewards high performance and the achievement of key milestones in ad spend supported by the content produced.We believe this structure will motivate our Video Editor to continuously strive for excellence, producing content that not only captivates audiences but also significantly contributes to the success of our e-commerce clients' campaigns.



To Apply:

To apply for this role, you will need to fill out this form: 
  that is 27 questions in total. You will then be asked to do a short project that displays your work with a loose brief and video resources provided showing your ability to take a brief and create a strong video creative from it. Once we review your video, we will set up an interview to the qualified candidates and then if you meet our standards then we would make a job offer.

title: AI-First Operations Manager (Claude Code / Codex) – Australian Based Adventure Travel
description:
We are a small Australian guided hiking and adventure travel company looking for an Operations Manager who does their best work with AI.



This is not a developer role. You won't write software or build automations; we have engineers for that. You will run the day-to-day operations of our trips and look after our customers, and you will use Claude Code (or Codex) heavily to assist in your work. If you only use ChatGPT in a browser, this role is probably not for you.



This is a long-term, full-time position for someone who can work exclusively with us. 



What you'll do:



- Make sure every trip runs smoothly: check bookings, participant details, transport, permits and supplier arrangements, and fix problems before customers notice them.

- Write customer replies by
, SMS and social media 
 and Instagram comments and messages) that are warm, clear, accurate and on-brand.

- Use Claude Code/Codex every day, connected to our booking,
, CRM and Notion systems, to look things up, cross-check details and prepare drafts quickly. Then check its work before anything goes out.

- Manage company permits and compliance reporting.

- Purchase company supplies.

- Support research and development of new trips.

- Spot problems and patterns, work out the cause, and come to us with a recommendation, not just a question.



About you:



- Extremely detail-oriented. You notice when a date, name, number or time doesn't match, and you check before you send.

- Excellent written and spoken English (C2). Your replies sound human and kind, even when AI helped draft them.

- A confident daily user of Claude Code or Codex. You give it context, point it at files and tools, review what it produces and know when it's wrong. Experience with MCP connectors is a big plus.

- You take initiative. You finish tasks without being chased, and when you're stuck you investigate before you ask.

- Strong analytical thinking. You can work out what's really going wrong in a messy situation and choose a sensible fix.

- Previous business experience. Ideally you have either run your own business in the past or have worked in roles with significant responsibility.  

- Experience in travel, tourism, hospitality or customer support is a plus but not required.



Tools you'll use:



Claude Code / Codex, Notion, Microsoft Teams, GoHighLevel, WeTravel and Zammad. You don't need experience with all of these, but you do need to be fluent in Claude Code or Codex from day one.



What we offer:



- Starting salary of AUD 1,150 per month, based on experience, with annual reviews and potential bonuses

- Working hours: 9:00 am – 5:00 pm (Philippine Time)

- 13th month pay

- Paid sick leave

- 25 flexible paid days off per year (including holidays)

- Fortnightly pay

- No requirement to use TimeProof



How to apply

1. Attach your CV.

2. Send a short video (1–2 minutes):

   - Start by saying "Hello Maddie" so we know it was made for this job.

   - Briefly introduce yourself and your work experience.

   - Describe one real task you completed with Claude Code or Codex in the last month: what you asked it to do, what it got wrong, and how you checked and fixed it.



Use the subject line: "Operations Manager + [Your Name] + [Your favourite AI model]"



Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: B2B Appointment Setter – Digital Marketing | Dallas–Fort Worth
description:
LocalWebDigital is looking for a confident, fluent English-speaking Appointment Setter to connect with service business owners across Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas.



We help local service businesses attract more customers online by combining effective website design, local search visibility, clear calls to action, easy contact options, and systems that follow up with inquiries. Your role is to start useful conversations, uncover growth opportunities, and book qualified appointments with our team.



This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys sales, listens carefully, asks thoughtful questions, and can turn a cold call into genuine interest.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Make outbound calls to service businesses in the Dallas–Fort Worth area, such as HVAC companies, plumbers, roofers, cleaners, landscapers, automotive, restaurants, home care clewaning, and other local service providers.

• Reach business owners or decision-makers, build rapport, and earn their attention with a relevant, concise opening.

• Ask discovery questions about how they attract customers, their online presence, website inquiries, and how they follow up with leads.

• Identify pain points and missed opportunities, such as low search visibility, a website that does not generate inquiries, confusing contact options, or leads that receive slow follow-up. Leads with opportunity gap will be mentioned as you gewt the decision maker to understand that as well.

• Explain how LocalWebDigital's services could address their needs in clear, everyday language. Build curiosity without making unsupported promises about rankings or results.

• Handle objections professionally, follow up consistently, and book appointments with interested, qualified decision-makers.

• Keep accurate CRM notes about each conversation, the prospect's needs, objections, next steps, and appointment details.

• Confirm appointments and communicate useful context to our team so each meeting starts with a clear understanding of the business.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Excellent spoken and written English, with clear, confident communication on calls with U.S. business owners.

• Experience in cold calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, or B2B sales, with specific examples of results.

• Strong listening, discovery, objection-handling, and follow-up skills.

• The ability to personalize a conversation instead of simply reading a script.

• Resilience, consistency, coachability, and ownership of your work.

• Comfort using a CRM, calling tools, and an appointment calendar.

• Reliable internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.

• Availability to make calls during Dallas–Fort Worth business hours in U.S. Central Time. Exact schedule and weekly hours will be agreed upon.



Experience selling websites, local SEO, digital marketing, or services to local businesses is a plus. You should be able to learn our services and explain their business value clearly.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

We value qualified appointments that prospects attend. We also track outreach activity, meaningful conversations, follow-up completion, appointment quality, and accurate CRM records.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line: DFW Appointment Setter – LocalWebDigital.



Include:

1. A brief summary of your relevant sales and appointment-setting experience.

2. Your past results, including the type of businesses you contacted and appointments booked, where available.

3. A short cold-call opening you would use with a Dallas service business owner, plus two discovery questions you would ask.

4. Your availability during U.S. Central Time business hours and your expected compensation.



Shortlisted applicants should be prepared for a brief English conversation and a realistic appointment-setting role-play.

That's the story. The reason people stay is what's under it: the investing, lending, property development and high-ticket sales I've actually done, and the strategy I use to plan every move back.



THE JOB

I film everything. You turn every minute of it into a YouTube channel people binge and a feed they can't scroll past.

• The podcast, the YouTube channel, 7am car rants, sales calls, whiteboard trainings, Looms, meetings, events and vlogs.

• A full-time videographer and an on-camera team are coming.

• A 40 minute training becomes a YouTube video, eight clips, a carousel, three posts and a quote card. Nothing gets used once.

• A headline hits the news at 9am. My take is cut over it by lunch.

• Short clips get strangers in. YouTube is where they d
 to trust me, so every clip sends them there or a funnel

• Views don't pay the bills. Every piece gives real value and points to a clear next step, so attention turns into booked calls and revenue.



WHAT YOU OWN EVERY WEEK

• The edits. A Loom can go up as it is. A rant needs to hit hard. You d
 which is which without asking me.

• The titles, thumbnails, descriptions and chapters.

• The posting on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X and
.

• The best clips from every podcast episode. The podcast has its own editor for the episode itself.

• The comments and DMs.

• A weekly report on what worked and what flopped, and why.

• The winners, handed to my ads editor to turn into paid ads.



WHAT YOU GET

• A real story and a real audience to build, not a faceless brand.

• A direct line to me. A 20 minute check-in every day, and no committee between you and a decision.

• A name of your own. As the team grows around this, you run content. I plan for that to be you.

• USD $1,000 to $1,300 a month depending on what you bring, plus a monthly bonus of up to $200 for hitting the numbers. Full-time, paid monthly.



YOU'RE THE ONE IF

• You've cut long-form and short-form for real channels and can show me the views.

• You know in the first two seconds if a hook is dead, and you'll tell me why.

• You'd take a clip that books calls over a viral clip that doesn't.

• You live in Claude, ChatGPT and whatever clipping tool dropped this week. You find clips in a transcript, draft hooks in batches and rewrite anything that sounds like a robot.

• You make the call and move.

• You want your name on something that's going somewhere.

• Fluent English, written and spoken. Manila hours, 9am to 6pm.



YOU'RE NOT IF

• Your portfolio is template talking-head cuts.

• You wait to be told what to do.

• You still do it all by hand.



HOW TO APPLY

There's a test. It takes about 90 minutes and it's the interview. Do it before I speak to anyone. No test, no call.

Everything you need is in this Google Drive folder: 
 

It holds a 46 minute screen recording of one of my trainings, five 3 minute side-angle phone clips of me recording it, a transcript and a news headline screenshot.

The transcript has mistakes, so check names and terms before you caption anything.

You don't need to do everything. I'd rather see 2 great clips than 6 rushed ones.



THE TEST

1. Clips. Pick the 5 best moments from the recording, with timestamps and one line on why for each. Edit 2 as vertical clips with captions: one punchy, one calm. Use a side angle in at least one.

2. Hooks. Write 3 different opening lines for your best clip, and tell me which you'd use.

3. The full video. Give me a YouTube title, 3 thumbnail ideas (a sketch or Canva mock is fine), a description with chapters, and a short plan for how you'd cut it, including where the side angles go.

4. Posts. Write one LinkedIn post and one X post from the training, in my voice. Then write a 30 second take on the headline and mock up the green screen: a frame of me over the headline, a highlight on the key line and big captions. A still image is enough.

5. Your AI. Record your screen (5 minutes max) showing how you used AI on the above: the tools, the prompts, what you kept and one thing you threw away. Use AI as much as you like. No screen recording, no score.



HOW TO SEND IT

• One
 to 
 with a Google Drive link (anyone with the link can view).

• Subject line: SASHA CONTENT. If it's wrong, I won't open it.

• Send it within 72 hours of opening the folder.

• I'll reply within 1 working day either way.

• I won't publish or use anything you send me. The files are confidential: don't share or post them, and delete them when you're done.

title: Executive Assistant — Scheduling & Research (Remote, Dubai Client)
description:
About ED-SG



ED-SG is a Singapore-based education consultancy. We help families relocating to UAE find the right international school for their child — not just the closest one, or the best-known one. In nine years we've guided more than 3,000 families across Singapore, Southeast Asia and the Middle East, and we hold a 4.9 customer service rating. 



We're growing, and we're hiring our first dedicated remote administrator.



The role



You'll be the person who makes the schedule work. School visits are the heart of what we do — a family flies in, and over two or three days they see the schools on their shortlist. Getting that right means coordinating school admissions offices, parents who are often still in another country, and a founder who is usually in a car somewhere between campuses.



You'll also research international schools online — fees, curricula, admissions timelines, facilities, waitlists — and write it up so it's genuinely usable.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role working UAE business hours.



What you'll be doing

Scheduling and coordinating school visits with admissions teams across Singapore

Making outbound calls to schools and families to arrange, confirm and follow up on appointments (we provide the calling system — you won't be paying for international calls)

Building and protecting the daily calendar, including realistic travel time between campuses

Managing the inbox — triaging, drafting and sending professional
s to schools, families and partners

Researching international schools online and writing clear, structured summaries

Keeping our school knowledge base accurate and current

Maintaining records in HubSpot — contacts, deals, activity logs and follow-up tasks

Preparing family profiles and shortlist documents ahead of consultations

General administrative support as the business grows



What we're looking for



Proactive. You notice the thing that's about to go wrong and fix it before it does. This matters to us more than years on a CV.

Confident on the phone. A real part of this job is calling school admissions offices and speaking on behalf of ED-SG. You need clear spoken English and the confidence to call someone you don't know.

Excellent written English. You'll be
ing schools and families directly, unsupervised.

Quick with technology. New system, no manual — you work it out.

Comfortable with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) and keen to use them to work faster. This is genuinely part of how we operate, not a buzzword on a job ad.

Strong with Google Workspace — Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets

CRM experience, ideally HubSpot, or able to learn it quickly

Organised under pressure and able to think on your feet when a school reschedules at short notice

Detail-focused — a wrong time or the wrong campus costs a family a morning they flew in for



Nice to have



Previous experience working directly with an overseas client (Singapore, Australia, UK, US)

Background in education, relocation, travel, real estate, or another appointment-heavy service business

Familiarity with international schools or the expat relocation world



Home office requirements



Reliable internet, minimum 25 Mbps, with a backup connection (mobile data or second provider)

Backup power arrangement for brownouts

Own computer, headset and a quiet space suitable for professional calls



The details



Type: Independent contractor, full-time, long-term

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm Philippine time

Location: Remote, anywhere in the Philippines

Rate: ₱45,000 – ₱60,000 per month, depending on experience

Paid: Monthly via Wise

Start: As soon as the right person is available



Why work with us



We're a small, growing company, so this role will grow too. The person who takes it on and runs with it can expect to take on more over time — process ownership, client-facing work, and helping build the team as we expand. You'll work directly with the founder and see the whole business, not one narrow slice of it. We're looking for someone to stay and grow with us, not to fill a seat for six months.

Title: Brand, Packaging & Creative Designer for New Premium Supplement Brand (Freelance, Long-Term Possible)

Our style is calm, premium and warm: think matte packaging, rich flavor colors and beautiful food photography, not loud neon gym branding.

How we work together

- Hours are flexible: we can start with a few hours per week (part-time) or more if there is enough work. Both are possible.

- If the collaboration goes well, this can grow into a long-term role with more hours and a higher rate as the brand grows.



What you will work on

- Brand identity: logo / wordmark, color palette, typography and simple brand guidelines

- Packaging design: stand-up pouches, tubs, protein bar wrappers and labels (print-ready files on supplier dielines)

- Product mockups and 3D packaging renders for our website and ads

- Social media graphics for Instagram and TikTok

- E-commerce design: Shopify homepage, product pages and banners (Figma)

Who we are looking for

- Strong portfolio with packaging and/or brand identity work (supplements, food or beverage is a big plus)

- Excellent eye for typography, layout and color

- Skilled in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop and/or Figma

- Experience preparing print-ready files (CMYK, bleed, dielines)

- Good written English and clear communication

- Reliable, meets deadlines and works well with feedback

What we offer

- Starting rate: $5 per hour, freelance

- Flexible hours: part-time to start, full-time possible later

title: Digital artist for children's picture books: retouching, book design and page checks (part-time)
description:
About us

We are a small business that makes personalised picture books for children. A family sends us photos and a story, and we turn them into a painted hardcover book. Before any book is printed, a person checks every page.



Pay

US$6 to 9 an hour depending on skill and experience, about 15 hours a week, paid monthly. Hours tracked with Timeproof. A raise after 3 months for good work, and more hours as we grow.



The job, in order of priority

1. Check every book before it prints. Open it in our review page in your web browser and check each page: the right number of fingers and toes, faces that match the family's photos, only the people and pets the family sent, words that are easy to read and spelt right. Each book takes about 5 to 10 minutes, and we need it checked within 12 hours of it being ready, any day of the week.

2. Fix what you find by hand. A hand with an extra finger, a foot on backwards, a small object that melted: repaint it in Photoshop or Procreate so it matches the painting around it.

3. Design themed books. Christmas, birthdays, a new baby: covers, opening and closing pages, page layouts and style references for our painting process.



Book checks always come first. Design work fills the rest of your hours.



Volume

Volume is low today and will grow fast when our advertising starts, so the share of time spent on checks will grow. This is a long-term role for the right person, with room to grow into a bigger part of the business.



You need

- a portfolio of digital painting, retouching or illustration

- Photoshop or Procreate

- excellent written English and a sharp eye for small details

- a laptop or desktop computer with a screen of 13 inches or more

- reliable internet, and time online every day so books are checked within 12 hours

- to keep the families' photos and names private



How to apply

Start your application with the words "gum tree" so we know you read this. Include a link to your portfolio, and tell us in 3 or 4 sentences about work you have done that needed close attention to detail.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial of about one hour (US$10): check 12 pictures, check a short text, and fix one hand in a painting.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

title: Highly Experienced Real Estate ISA | Appointment Setter
description:
We are an established Arizona real estate brokerage looking for a highly experienced, results driven Real Estate ISA to join our team.



This is NOT an entry level ISA position.



We are looking for someone who already knows how to work a real estate database, engage leads, build genuine rapport, uncover motivation, handle objections, follow up consistently and turn conversations into appointments.



If you need to be taught how to talk to leads, this is not the position for you.



If you know how to take a lead who says, “I’m just looking,” have a natural conversation, earn their trust, discover what they actually need and create a legitimate opportunity for one of our agents, we want to hear from you.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want a strong ISA, but we are not looking for an aggressive, scripted or pushy salesperson.



You should be persuasive without making people feel pressured.



You should know how to guide a conversation without dominating it.



You should be confident enough to ask for the appointment, but personable enough that the prospect actually wants to meet with our agent.



Our preferred communication style is warm, conversational, confident and genuine.



We believe the best ISAs don’t sound like salespeople. They sound like knowledgeable, helpful people who know how to listen, ask the right questions and build trust.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Your primary responsibility will be turning opportunities in our database into meaningful conversations and qualified appointments for our agents.



Responsibilities will include:



• Working buyer and seller leads within our CRM

• Responding quickly to new inbound leads

• Calling, texting and following up with existing database contacts

• Nurturing long term prospects who are not ready today

• Re engaging older and inactive leads

• Qualifying buyer and seller motivation

• Identifying timelines, needs and opportunities

• Handling common objections naturally and confidently

• Scheduling qualified buyer and listing appointments for our agents

• Maintaining accurate notes, tasks, stages and follow up plans in the CRM

• Making sure leads do not disappear because someone forgot to follow up

• Participating in targeted outbound campaigns when we identify specific opportunities

• Following up consistently without becoming annoying or overly aggressive

• Communicating important lead information to our agents so they are prepared before appointments



This position requires someone who understands that the fortune really is in the follow up.



EXPERIENCE WE EXPECT



We are specifically looking for an experienced Real Estate ISA.



You should already have significant experience with:



• Real estate lead conversion

• Buyer and seller lead qualification

• Database management

• CRM lead management

• Appointment setting

• Lead nurturing

• Long term follow up

• Database reactivation

• Objection handling

• Phone, text and CRM communication

• Building rapport quickly

• Recognizing when a conversation has turned into a real opportunity



Experience working with a U.S. real estate brokerage or team is strongly preferred.



Experience with distressed sellers, expired listings, old leads, internet leads or seller lead generation is a plus.



SPOKEN ENGLISH IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You will communicate directly with our U.S. clients and prospects every day.



Your spoken English must be exceptionally fluent, natural, clear and easily understood by U.S. clients.



We need someone with excellent conversational English who is comfortable with the pace, vocabulary and back and forth of a natural conversation with an American client.



This is not simply about grammar.



We are listening for communication skills.



Can you make someone comfortable?



Can you keep a conversation going?



Can you listen instead of waiting for your turn to speak?



Can you make someone laugh?



Can you recognize hesitation in someone’s voice?



Can you ask another question instead of immediately jumping back to your script?



Can you confidently ask for an appointment without suddenly sounding like a salesperson?



Those skills matter to us.



WE DO NOT WANT A ROBOT



Please don’t misunderstand “experienced ISA” to mean aggressive salesperson.



We don’t want someone hammering through a script trying to get an appointment at any cost.



We want personality.



Be friendly. Be curious. Be confident. Have a sense of humor. Listen to people.



Our goal is for prospects to feel like they are having a conversation with someone they know and trust, not someone working through a call sheet.



Scripts and systems have their place. Rapport comes first.



THE PERSON WHO WILL DO WELL HERE



You are competitive and like getting results, but you also genuinely like talking to people.



You don’t give up after 2 attempts.



You don’t need someone reminding you which leads need follow up.



You understand that “not right now” doesn’t necessarily mean “never.”



You know the difference between persistence and pestering.



You take excellent notes because you understand that the next conversation should continue where the previous one ended.



And when you schedule an appointment, our agent should receive more than a name and phone number. They should understand who this person is, what they need, their motivation, their timeline and what matters to them.



SCHEDULE



Monday through Friday

9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Arizona Time

1 hour lunch off



Please make sure you understand the time difference between the Philippines and Arizona before applying.



You must be able to consistently work this schedule and have a reliable computer, internet connection, headset and professional work environment suitable for daily phone conversations.



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



For the initial screening, please send us ONLY the following 2 required items:



1. Your current resume



2. A 60 to 90 second voice recording 



In your recording, introduce yourself, tell us about your ISA experience and tell us why you think you would be a great fit for our team.



But here’s the important part:



Don’t give us your formal interview voice.



Talk to us like you would talk to a new lead you genuinely enjoyed speaking with.



We want to hear your personality.



Be conversational. Be confident. Have some fun with it. Tell us something that makes us want to keep talking to you.



We’re evaluating much more than pronunciation. We’re listening for rapport, warmth, confidence, personality, conversational ability and how naturally you communicate.



BOTH ITEMS ARE REQUIRED.



If you do not submit BOTH a resume AND a voice recording, you will NOT be considered for this position.

description:

This role combines technical leadership, product delivery and team management. You’ll work closely with our leadership team and developers, providing clear direction while remaining involved in architecture, technical decisions and solving complex problems.



What you’ll be responsible for



Own the technical roadmap: Translate business goals into clear priorities, development milestones and achievable release plans across our products.



Lead our internal development team: Collaborate with developers, assign and oversee tasks, remove blockers and hold the team accountable for quality and delivery.



Drive product development: Deliver new features, improve existing functionality and ensure our products solve practical problems for agents, property owners and customers.



Set the technical direction: Oversee architecture, databases, infrastructure and integrations so our platforms can grow sustainably.



Maintain quality and reliability: Establish strong practices for code reviews, testing, documentation, deployment and ongoing maintenance.



Oversee integrations and automation: Guide API integrations, data flows and AI-powered functionality across our products.



Protect our systems and data: Take ownership of security, access controls, backups and platform resilience.



Connect business and technology: Explain technical decisions clearly, manage competing priorities and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks and timelines.



What we’re looking for



Experience as a CTO, Head of Engineering, Technical Lead or senior engineering leader with responsibility for product delivery.



A strong hands-on background in full-stack development, SaaS platforms, APIs and database architecture.



Proven experience leading developers and managing multiple products or development streams.



The ability to assess an existing codebase, identify weaknesses and implement practical improvements.



Strong judgement around what to build, what to improve and where to focus development resources.



Experience with cloud infrastructure, security, deployment processes and scalable systems.



Clear communication, strong organisation and a willingness to take ownership from planning through to release.



Experience with CRM systems, property technology, workflow automation or AI integrations would be highly regarded.



Why join Collings?



You’ll have a direct role in shaping a growing technology portfolio, with access to the people who use our products and the leadership team setting the vision.



This is an opportunity to influence both what we build and how we build it, develop the capabilities of our internal team and see your work put into practice across the business.



Apply

description:

title: Content Marketing & Customer Journey Lead - Luxury Travel
description:
About the role

Luxeworld - A luxury travel agency in Sydney, Australia - is seeking a commercially minded Content Marketing & Customer Journey Lead to develop and coordinate our content and campaign activity across the customer journey.

The role will turn Luxeworld's destination expertise, travel inspiration, experiences and offers into compelling content and integrated campaigns across our website,
, social media, digital advertising and partner channels.

You will work closely with the Luxeworld team, our designer, SEO/AEO agency, digital advertising agency and travel partners to ensure our marketing is coordinated, consistent and ultimately generates quality travel enquiries.



Key responsibilities



Content & campaign planning

Own and maintain a rolling 12 month content and campaign calendar.

Turn destinations, travel trends, seasonal opportunities and Luxeworld offers into compelling campaigns and content.

Coordinate content across website,
, social, digital advertising and partner channels.

Make best use of AI tools for creation of content



Customer journeys & lead generation

Develop customer journeys from initial travel inspiration through to enquiry.

Identify opportunities for lead magnets such as destination guides, luxury itineraries and travel planning resources.

Develop content and communications that nurture prospective travellers and encourage enquiries.

Ensure website content has clear and relevant calls to action.



Website content

Manage the ongoing Luxeworld website content plan.

Brief, edit and/or commission articles, destination guides, itineraries and other content.

Load and maintain content through the website CMS.

Work with the SEO/AEO agency to implement their recommendations.

Identify opportunities to improve content structure, internal linking and customer pathways.



Content distribution

Coordinate the dissemination of Luxeworld's content, offers and travel information across all relevant channels.

Work with the designer on social media and newsletter content and publishing.

Brief the digital advertising agency on campaigns, offers, audiences and landing pages.



Partnerships

Identify opportunities to collaborate on content with luxury hotels, tourism organisations, airlines, travel suppliers and complementary luxury brands.

Develop mutually beneficial content initiatives that extend Luxeworld's reach and provide value to prospective travellers.



Coordination & measurement

Coordinate content-related activity across internal resources, agencies and suppliers.

Monitor content and campaign performance, including engagement, leads and enquiries.

Use results to continually improve the content calendar and customer journeys.



What we're looking for

Experience in content marketing, digital marketing or a related role.

Strong content planning, project management and editorial skills.

Experience developing customer journeys and lead-generation content.

Excellent writing and editing skills, albeit with support of AI tools

Experience working with a website CMS.

Strong understanding of digital marketing and SEO principles.

Commercial mindset with an understanding of how content contributes to enquiries and revenue.

Excellent organisational and stakeholder-management skills.

Ability to work independently and coordinate agencies, suppliers and partners.



Experience in luxury travel, tourism, hospitality or another premium consumer category would be highly desirable.

The ideal person



You are strategic enough to see the bigger picture, but hands-on enough to build the calendar, brief content, edit copy, update the website and keep campaigns moving.

You understand that luxury travel marketing is about more than generating traffic — it is about inspiring travellers, building trust, demonstrating expertise and ultimately creating quality client relationships.

Content Marketing & Customer Journey Lead: Content strategy, campaigns, customer journeys, content distribution and coordination.

Designer: Creative development and day-to-day social/newsletter publishing.

SEO/AEO agency: Technical SEO, AEO and specialist search strategy.

The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week

I. Initial Interview

II. Activity Video (Applicant must complete the activity video)

III. Final Interview

title: YouTube Automation Operations VA – YTA Experience Required
description:
## Job Title

**YouTube Automation Operations VA – YTA Experience Required**



## Type of Employment

Part-Time to Start  

Opportunity to grow into a larger / full-time role



## Compensation

**$100 USD per month fixed salary during a 90-day trial period**



This position begins with a **90-day part-time trial**. The trial gives us time to evaluate your communication, reliability, organization, YTA knowledge, and ability to keep the production team on schedule.



If you perform well during the 90-day trial, there will be an opportunity for more responsibility, additional channels, increased hours, increased compensation, and potentially a full-time role.



## About the Channels



We are building and operating **multiple faceless YouTube Automation channels across different niches**.



A few examples of the type of channels we study are:











These are examples for reference only. We are **not copying these channels**, and our channels will cover a variety of different topics and audiences.



The niches may change, but the production process is generally the same:



**Topic → Research → Script → Voiceover → Video Editing → Thumbnail → Review → Upload → Publish**



Your responsibility will be to make sure this process stays organized and moves on schedule across every channel.



## Job Description



We are looking for an organized, responsive, and experienced **YouTube Automation VA / Operations Coordinator**.



You will not primarily be writing scripts, making thumbnails, or editing videos. We are hiring separate specialists for those roles.



Your job is to **coordinate the entire workflow and keep everyone on schedule**.



You will work directly with:



- Script writers

- Video editors

- Thumbnail designers

- Management/owner



## Main Responsibilities



### Production Coordination

- Manage videos from topic selection through publishing

- Coordinate writers, editors, thumbnail designers, and voiceover workflow

- Assign and track deadlines

- Make sure each step is finished before the next person needs it

- Follow up immediately when something is late

- Coordinate revisions

- Maintain a consistent publishing schedule

- Identify bottlenecks before they delay uploads

- Manage production across multiple channels and niches



### Trello / Project Management

- Maintain our Trello boards

- Create and organize video cards

- Assign deadlines

- Track each video through its production stages

- Maintain revision notes

- Keep team members accountable

- Make it easy for management to see exactly where every channel and video stands



### YouTube Channel Setup & Operations

- Help set up new YouTube channels

- Organize branding and channel information

- Coordinate uploads

- Schedule videos

- Maintain publishing calendars

- Confirm titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and video files are ready before publication



### Channel Warm-Up & Account Management

You should already understand the process of preparing new YouTube accounts before launching channels.



Responsibilities may include:



- YouTube account warm-up

- GoLogin browser profiles

- Proxy setup and organization

- Maintaining separate browser/account environments

- Keeping account information organized

- Following our internal procedures for account management



Experience with **GoLogin, proxies, browser profiles, and YouTube account warm-up is strongly preferred.**



### Communication



You must be a strong communicator.



You will be expected to:



- Respond quickly

- Follow up with team members

- Remind people about upcoming deadlines

- Address missed deadlines

- Escalate problems when necessary

- Provide management with short, clear status updates



We want someone who takes ownership.



If an editor is late, we should not have to discover it ourselves three days later.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Please **do not apply if you have never worked directly with YouTube Automation / faceless YouTube channels.**



We are specifically looking for experience with:



- YouTube Automation / YTA

- Faceless YouTube channels

- Managing the script → voiceover → edit → thumbnail → upload workflow

- Managing writers, editors, and designers

- Trello or similar project-management tools

- YouTube channel setup

- Channel warm-up

- GoLogin or similar browser-profile tools

- Proxies

- Coordinating deadlines across multiple videos



You should be:



- Organized

- Fast

- Reliable

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable following up with people

- Clear in written English

- Able to work without constant supervision



## IMPORTANT: APPLICATIONS



Please do **not** send us a generic cover letter.



We are specifically looking for people who have actually done this work.



We also prefer that you **do not use AI to write your application answers.** We want to understand how you personally communicate and think.



Generic, overly polished, vague, or obviously AI-generated answers will not help your application.



Short, direct answers are better.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



**YTA OPERATIONS**



Then answer the questions below.



### 1. Your Actual YTA Experience

How long have you personally worked with faceless / YouTube Automation channels?



Tell us:



- Approximately when you started

- How many channels you worked on

- Whether you were a VA, channel manager, project manager, uploader, researcher, etc.



### 2. Channels You Have Actually Worked On

Please provide **actual examples of YouTube channels you have worked with.**



For each channel, provide as much of the following as you are permitted to share:



- Channel name

- YouTube URL

- Niche

- Approximate subscriber count while you worked there

- Approximate average views

- Your exact responsibilities

- How long you worked on the channel

- Approximate upload frequency



If you cannot publicly disclose the channel because of an NDA, explain that and provide another form of proof such as:



- Screenshot of the YouTube Studio dashboard with sensitive information removed

- Screenshot of your Trello/production board

- Screenshot showing your involvement

- Reference from the channel owner



Please do **not** simply say, “I worked on several successful channels.”



We want actual information.



### 3. Describe One Channel

Choose ONE channel you worked on and briefly explain its production process from:



**Topic → Script → Voiceover → Editing → Thumbnail → Upload**



Tell us who did each step and what you were responsible for.



### 4. Trello

Tell us specifically how you used Trello in a previous YTA operation.



What lists or stages did your board have?



Please answer based on your actual experience rather than describing how Trello works generally.



### 5. Missed Deadline

Tell us about a **real situation** where a writer, editor, or thumbnail designer missed a deadline.



What happened?



What did you personally do?



What was the outcome?



### 6. Channel Warm-Up

Explain how you have personally warmed up a new YouTube account/channel before publishing.



We are not asking for a definition of “channel warm-up.”



Tell us what **you actually did**, approximately how long you did it, and what tools you used.



### 7. GoLogin & Proxies

Have you personally used:



- GoLogin

- Proxies

- Multiple browser profiles

- Multiple YouTube accounts



If yes, explain exactly what you used them for.



Please name the proxy provider or type of proxy you have used if you remember.



### 8. Production Problem

Imagine this situation:



It is Tuesday.



A video is scheduled for Thursday.



The script is complete, but the editor was supposed to deliver Monday and has stopped responding.



The thumbnail designer is waiting for the finished video concept.



**Tell us exactly what you would do during the next 30 minutes.**



Please answer this in your normal writing style.



### 9. Your Biggest Mistake

Tell us about **one mistake you personally made while working on a YouTube Automation channel**.



What happened, and what did you change afterward?



There is no “correct” answer.



### 10. Availability

What hours are you normally online in Philippine time?



How quickly can you normally respond during your working hours?



### 11. Other Clients

Are you currently working for another employer or YTA operation?



If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



### 12. Direct Work

Will **you personally** be doing this job?



We do not want this position subcontracted to another VA.



### Final Question

Without researching it, tell us:



**What is one small thing that usually causes unnecessary delays in a YouTube Automation production workflow?**



Answer in **one or two sentences only.**



---



We are not looking for the longest application.



We are looking for someone who has **real YTA experience, communicates clearly, moves quickly, and can keep an entire production team organized without constant supervision.**



This position begins with a **90-day trial at $100/month**. Strong performance can lead to a larger role as we launch and manage more channels.

description:
We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and results-driven Appointment Setter & Business Development Specialist to help Plenti Mortgage expand our network of real estate agents and professional referral partners across the United States.



The ideal candidate has strong outbound calling and relationship-building experience, excellent English communication skills, and the ability to manage business development activities independently.



Key Responsibilities:



Research, identify, and qualify potential real estate agents and business partners.



Build, organize, and prioritize prospect lists based on business potential.



Conduct outbound calls to introduce our services, build relationships, and schedule qualified appointments.



Reconnect with past partners and strengthen existing business relationships.



Handle objections professionally and conduct consistent follow-ups.



Manage prospect information, outreach activities, appointments, and follow-up schedules in Zoho CRM.



Execute outreach campaigns through phone,
, and other approved communication channels.



Track performance metrics, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide regular progress updates.



Take ownership of assigned campaigns and independently manage daily priorities.



Required Qualifications:



Minimum 2 years of experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, lead generation, or business development.



Experience communicating with U.S.-based clients or business professionals.



Excellent spoken and written English.



Strong communication, persuasion, and objection-handling skills.



Proficiency with CRM systems, online research, and business productivity tools.



Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.



Ability to work independently, solve problems, and learn new systems quickly.



Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment.



U.S. real estate or mortgage experience is a plus, but not required.



We're Looking for Someone Who:



Takes initiative, understands business objectives, and delivers results without constant supervision. You should be resourceful, dependable, accountable, receptive to feedback, and comfortable taking ownership of your work.



This is not an entry-level or general administrative VA position. We provide training on our mortgage products and internal processes, but expect candidates to already possess strong foundational skills in outbound calling, prospecting, and appointment setting.



Compensation: ₱30,000–50,000 per month (Full-Time Equivalent)



Final compensation will depend on experience, demonstrated skills, English communication ability, and assessment results.



We offer a long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. company, structured onboarding, performance reviews, and opportunities for professional and career growth.



How to Apply / Contact



Interested applicants should apply through OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 with the subject line:



Application – Appointment Setter & Business Development Specialist



Please include:



Your updated resume.



A 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your outbound calling experience.



Your previous appointment-setting results, including typical daily call volume and weekly qualified appointments.



CRM systems you have used.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and skill assessement.



We're looking for a dependable, resourceful, and motivated professional who wants to grow with Plenti Mortgage for the long term.

title: AI Video Creator
description:
We're not hiring someone to "make videos." We're hiring someone to move humans — to take the raw clay of footage, AI tools, and a story worth telling, and shape it into something that makes a stranger stop scrolling, lean in, and feel something real. Then act on it.





Who You Are 



You're a Storyteller First, Technologist Second. Anyone can prompt an AI tool. Almost nobody can tell a story that makes a CFO tear up at a B2B brand video. That's the gap we're hiring for.



You're Emotionally Intelligent — and It Shows in the Work. You can read a room, read a brief, and read a person's face on camera and know when they're holding back. You understand that great marketing isn't about being clever — it's about being true. You make people feel seen. That's the unfair advantage you bring.







- You're Motivated by Impact, Not Output. You don't measure your week in videos shipped. You measure it in whether the work moved someone — a customer, a candidate, a community. You'd rather make 10 videos that matter than 100 that don't.



- You Have Range. You can make us laugh on Tuesday and make us cry on Thursday. You can write a 15-second hook and a 6-minute brand film. You can shoot on an iPhone in a coffee shop and direct a polished studio piece.



You Move Fast Without Breaking Trust. You ship. You iterate. You don't disappear into perfectionism for three weeks. But you also don't publish anything you wouldn't be proud to sign your name to.



You're a Pro With AI — Not a Tourist. You've already built workflows nobody taught you. You know which tools are hype and which are durable. You know when to use AI and, more importantly, when not to.







Non-Negotiables



- Portfolio that makes us jealous. Show us the work. We'd rather see three pieces you're proud of than a sizzle reel of everything you've ever touched.

- 3+ years producing video for marketing or brand, ideally in a fast-moving environment where you weren't handed a 50-page brand book.

- Demonstrated AI fluency. You can walk us through a video you made where AI was central to the workflow — and explain the choices, including the human ones.

- Strong writing. If you can't write, you can't make great video. Period.

- You actually like people. This job involves real humans on camera. They'll feel how you feel about them.



The chance to build something. A team that takes the work seriously and themselves lightly. Direct line to leadership — your ideas get heard, your wins get noticed, your work goes out the door. Compensation that matches the talent we're looking for. And the rare gift of doing work you can point to in five years and say: that one mattered.

title: Cold Caller for a Real Estate Photography Business: Appointment Setter (Part Time, Long Term)
description:
Cold Caller for a Real Estate Photography Business: Appointment Setter (Part Time, Long Term)



READ FIRST: Applications without a short video will not be reviewed. Instructions are at the bottom.



IMPORTANT: This is a real estate MEDIA business (photography, drone, video, virtual tours). It is NOT a real estate brokerage. You will not help anyone buy or sell homes, and you will not handle transactions, contracts, escrow or paperwork. If you are looking for a realtor assistant, transaction coordinator, ISA or property management role, do not apply.



ABOUT US

Real Estate PHOTO Media is a growing real estate photography and video business in Southern California. We've shot 300+ homes this year for real estate agents across the Inland Empire and Orange County, with photos, drone, video and 3D tours delivered the next day.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

You call active real estate agents, start a real conversation, and book their next photo shoot with me.



This is calls only and outbound only. You will not send DMs, texts or
s, and you will not handle inbound inquiries.



You MUST have cold calling experience with the REPP method or Eli Jones's approach. Applicants without this experience will not be considered.



THE OFFER

Qualified agents get a free vertical video with their first paid shoot. This is the only offer you can make.



WHO QUALIFIES

An agent qualifies only if they:

- Work in Riverside County (Inland Empire) or Orange County

- Have at least 5 listings in the last 12 months, confirmed on their 
 agent profile

- Are booking a residential listing (house, condo or townhome)

Do not call, offer the free video to, or book anyone who does not meet all three.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Build the Call List

- Use 
 to find agents who qualify

- Add every agent to a Google Sheet: name, phone, brokerage, city, listings in the last 12 months



2. Cold Calls

- Make 60 to 100 dials per shift using my script

- Use a pattern interrupt opener, qualify in 30 seconds, then book or move on

- Ask about their upcoming listings

- Handle common objections naturally using my approved responses

- Log every dial in the Google Sheet: date called, outcome, follow up date

- Call agents back on a 60 to 90 day cycle if they said not now



3. Booking in Spiro

- When an agent is ready to book, collect the property address, square footage, date and

- Book the shoot in Spiro yourself using my standard package pricing, with the free vertical video added. Never send the agent a booking link

- Double check every booking: correct address, date, package and add-ons

- Send me every booking on WhatsApp right away so I can confirm my schedule

- Never offer discounts or anything besides the free vertical video



4. Daily Reports

- Start of day WhatsApp message at the start of your shift

- End of day WhatsApp message with counts: agents added, dials, conversations, follow ups set, shoots booked

- Weekly 15 minute video check in



WORK RULES

- Start and end at your agreed time every day

- Clock in and out using the time tracker I provide. It only runs while you are clocked in

- All daily tasks must be complete before you clock out

- Only do the tasks listed here. If you think something else needs doing, ask me first

- Only bill for time you actually worked

- Follow my script, but sound like a real person. Never aggressive, pushy or robotic

- Never ask an agent who their current photographer is

- Only call from the phone number I provide

- Dial every number by hand. No auto-dialers

- If anyone asks not to be called, mark them in the sheet and never call them again

- Send me any pricing questions outside my standard packages, commercial properties or complaints on WhatsApp within 1 hour



REQUIREMENTS

- Required: cold calling experience using the REPP method or Eli Jones's approach

- 1+ year cold calling experience for a US business (appointment setting, SDR or similar)

- Proven results: booked appointments or closed sales from cold calls

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent that Americans understand on the first try

- Friendly, confident and upbeat. Agents can hear you smiling

- Comfortable with rejection. Most calls will be a no, and you move on with a good attitude

- Must learn and use Spiro to book every shoot. I will train you during your first week. Spiro experience is a big plus

- Follows scripts and instructions exactly and asks when unsure

- USB headset with a noise cancelling microphone (no laptop mic or Bluetooth earbuds)

- Quiet room during your shift

- Stable internet plus a backup connection (mobile hotspot) and backup power

- WhatsApp for daily communication



NICE TO HAVE

- Cold calling experience in real estate, mortgage, insurance or home services

- Has closed B2B services on cold calls, not just set appointments



SCHEDULE

20 hours per week, Monday to Friday. 4 hours per shift between 8am and 4pm Pacific Time. Keep the same shift every day.



PAY

$6 per hour USD, plus a $10 bonus per completed shoot. Paid weekly via Wise. The first week is a paid trial.



HOW THE BONUS WORKS

When you book a qualified agent who has never worked with me before, that agent is yours for 90 days. You earn $10 for every completed, paid shoot they book with me during those 90 days, not just the first one. If your agent books 4 shoots in 90 days, you earn $40 from that one agent.



GROWTH

This is long-term work with a growing business. Hours increase in spring, and this role can grow into a full-time position as the business grows.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Record a 60 to 90 second video with your face on camera (use your headset if you have one). Start by saying:

"Hi Abidur, I'm applying for the cold calling role at Vista Media Homes."

Then introduce yourself and your cold calling experience, including any REPP or Eli Jones work and your results. Then read this out loud like you're on a real call:

"Hi Jessica, this is [your name] calling for Vista Media Homes. I saw your new listing on Oak Street, nice home. I help agents in the Inland Empire and Orange County get their listings shot with photos, drone and video, delivered the next day. Do you have a quick minute?"



2. Upload it to Loom, Google Drive or unlisted YouTube, and make sure anyone with the link can view it.



3. In your application, include:

- The words "VISTA CALLS" at the top of your message so I know you read the whole post

- Your video link

- Your other cold calling experience: company names, how long, what you sold and your daily dial volume

- What booking system or CRM you have used, and whether you have used Spiro

- A screenshot of a speed test from this week, plus your backup internet and power

- Your headset brand and model



Applications without a video, or that skip a step, will not be reviewed.
