title: Part-Time WordPress Developer
description:
## About InSync Media



InSync Media is a digital marketing agency based in Colorado. We build websites and run SEO and AI search programs for home builders and service businesses. Our small team works remotely across the U.S. and the Philippines. 



## The Role



Our web designer runs our whole web program. She handles page designs, client communication, project management, hosting, and maintenance. Our website projects create more work than one person can finish. We need a reliable WordPress developer to take a large share of that work off her plate.



You will report to our lead designer. You will own five areas: updates and security, support tickets, forms and integrations, ACF and custom code, and page builds from our designs.



This is a part-time contract role that we plan to grow into a full-time role. It starts at 10 hours per week. Your hours will grow as you learn our sites and systems.



## You'd Be a Great Fit If You...



- Take a backup before you touch anything, even when the update looks minor.

- Click through the site after an update instead of assuming it worked.

- Notice the details others miss, like a button that moved or an image that went blurry.

- Want to find out why something broke, not patch over it.

- Follow an SOP and suggest improvements when it needs updating.

- Work through a ticket queue on your own and ask questions when something is unclear.

- Write down what you changed so the next person can follow it.

- Can handle a small text swap and a complex ACF debug in the same week.

- Use the theme builder's options before writing custom code, and leave client sites cleaner than you found them.

- Speak up early when you are stuck or a task will take longer than planned.



## What You Will Do



### 1. WordPress, Theme, and Plugin Updates and Security



- Run monthly core, theme, and plugin updates on client sites. Take a WP Engine backup first.

- Check each site afterward. Confirm pages load, forms submit, tracking fires, the cookie banner shows, and mobile layouts hold.

- Roll back and fix any update that breaks a site.

- Recommend when a large core or theme update should wait.

- Improve page speed and Core Web Vitals.

- Run security scans, clean up malware, and track plugin and theme licenses.



### 2. Support Tickets



- Complete client and team requests in ClickUp, from content swaps to bug fixes.

- Fix broken forms, layouts, menus, maps, images, and mobile display issues.

- Fix plugin conflicts and PHP errors.

- Install privacy policy and cookie consent banners.

- Keep a log of the changes you make.



### 3. Forms and Integrations



- Build Gravity Forms and connect them to CRMs and
 platforms such as HighLevel, HubSpot, and Constant Contact.

- Set up Zapier when no native integration exists.

- Set up notification
s, auto-replies, and SMTP so the site can send
.

- Test every form from submission to the CRM or inbox.



### 4. ACF and Custom Code



- Build and edit ACF field groups, custom post types, and templates.

- Troubleshoot ACF fields that stop saving or displaying.

- Maintain Divi child themes and custom PHP. Restore changes when an update or another developer overwrites them.



### 5. Page and Site Builds



- Build pages and full sites from Photoshop designs or AI-generated HTML mockups.

- Build in Divi first. Some clients use WPBakery, Elementor, or Oxygen.

- Use the builder's native modules. Add custom HTML or CSS only when the builder cannot do the job.

- Test sites across browsers and devices.

- Launch sites, handle DNS updates, and migrate sites to WP Engine.



## Requirements



- 5 or more years of hands-on WordPress development

- Expert-level ACF Pro, including repeaters, flexible content, relationship fields, options pages, and custom post types

- Able to build a template file from scratch that displays ACF data

- Strong PHP in WordPress themes and child themes

- Strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

- Experience with several page builders, especially Divi

- Experience turning design files into Divi pages with native modules

- Experience connecting WordPress forms to CRMs and
 platforms, including through Zapier

- Experience running updates on live client sites and fixing what breaks

- Experience improving page speed with PageSpeed Insights or GTmetrix

- Experience with WP Engine or another managed WordPress host

- Clear written English. Most of our communication happens in ClickUp and
.

- A reliable computer and internet connection, plus a backup plan for outages



## Nice to Have



- Experience cleaning up hacked WordPress sites

- Agency experience supporting many client sites at once

- Shopify and Wix experience



## Schedule and Pay



- **Hours:** 10 hours per week to start, with more hours as you grow into this role.

- **Schedule:** Set your own hours. You must be online for at least 2 hours between 8:00 and 10:00 a.m. Mountain Time on weekdays. That is 10:00 p.m. to midnight Philippine time through October 31. It shifts to 11:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m. after U.S. daylight saving time ends on November 1.

- **Location:** Fully remote. Open to candidates in the Philippines and other countries.

- **Pay:** $15 to $20 per hour, paid twice a month.

- **Contract:** Independent contractor.

- **Growth:** A path to full-time hours and owning significant portions of our web program as you become independent.



## How to Apply



Message me on this platform. Start your message with the words "ORANGE BALLOON." Include:



1. Your resume.

2. Links to 2 or 3 WordPress sites you built or maintained. If you worked as part of a team, tell us about your specific role in the project.

3. A short description of a custom ACF build you are proud of. Name the field types you used and how the data displayed on the page.

4. A short description of a time an update broke a site. Explain how you found the cause and fixed it.

5. Your availability to start

6. If you are looking for part time or full time work

title: Automotive Operations Coordinator
description:
Automotive Operations & Dispatch Coordinator

-We’re hiring a high-performing, detail-obsessed Operations Coordinator to help us run and grow a mobile automotive shop in Austin, Texas — a premium mobile tire and oil change business serving performance car owners and select fleets in the Austin metro area.

This is a hybrid customer-facing and backend operations role. You’ll be responsible for making sure the daily work gets done accurately, efficiently, and on time — coordinating jobs, processing approvals, managing tech schedules, tracking AR, and keeping our customers in the loop.

You’ll also assist with light marketing coordination (e.g., newsletter support, gathering photos from the team) — just a few hours weekly.



Key Responsibilities

1. Fleet & Retail Ops Coordination

--Own the estimate-to-approval-to-route workflow:

--Create and submit estimates

--Follow up for approval

--Ensure parts are sourced

--Finalize tech routes for the following day

--Track all jobs in progress and flag issues proactively

--Ensure routes are realistic and efficient; confirm techs are prepped and ready

--Communicate clearly with customers and fleet managers about job timing, status, and follow-ups

--Submit and close out fleet approvals in Element, LeasePlan, and AutoIntegrate

--Ensure invoices match approvals; follow up on outstanding invoices and missing payments

2. Scheduling & Productivity Tracking

--Maintain the daily technician schedule, making updates as needed

--Monitor tech productivity; flag idle time, reschedules, or delays

--Track time logs and coordinate with bookkeeper for payroll

3. Customer Communication

--Respond to incoming texts, WhatsApp messages, and system inquiries in a timely, professional manner

--Follow up with clients as needed to resolve open issues or gather job-related info

--Escalate concerns appropriately and promptly

4. Admin & Reporting

--Submit a detailed Daily Recap covering completed work, pending tasks, blockers, and KPIs

--Keep Trello and other tools up-to-date with accurate job and task statuses

--Track inventory needs and coordinate ordering of parts, oil, and supplies

--Monitor A/R and follow up on past-due fleet invoices

5. Marketing & Content Support 

--Publish our monthly newsletter in MailChimp with content from marketing team

--Coordinate publishing of content to Instagram /
 / Google My Business

--Other light admin support as needed for the marketing team



What Success Looks Like

-All work orders, estimates, approvals, and tech routes are handled with zero dropped balls

-You identify blockers or problems before they become fires

-Communication is clear, timely, and professional — with both customers and internal team

-The business runs like a machine — nothing gets missed or delayed

-You take full ownership of your responsibilities and require very little follow-up



Who You Are

-A natural systems thinker who thrives on clarity, organization, and ownership

-Extremely proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do

-Excellent at written and verbal English communication

-Comfortable in the automotive world and eager to learn the details

-Sharp and reliable — you retain info, spot gaps, and follow through



Experience & Skills Required

-3+ years of experience in a remote automotive: coordinator, dispatcher, operations role

-Demonstrated responsibility for keeping things moving without handholding

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Experience with dispatch, route planning, or technician scheduling

-Familiar with tools like Slack, Google Docs, Trello (or similar), CRM/invoicing platforms

-Experience working with U.S.-based field service, auto, or fleet companies

-Bonus: Familiarity with AutoIntegrate, Housecall Pro, Element, or LeasePlan platforms



Required Software Experience

-Slack

-WhatsApp

-Trello (or similar)

-Google Workspace

-CRM / invoicing tools (Housecall Pro, AutoIntegrate)


 (plus)



TECH REQUIREMENTS:

-Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

title: Experienced Media Buyer
description:
FULL-TIME GOOGLE ADS /
 ADS MANAGER / MEDIA BUYER



Performance Marketing | Paid Advertising | Lead Generation



We are looking for a highly driven, analytical, and results-focused Media Buyer to join our team full-time.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that successful paid advertising is about more than simply launching campaigns. You should enjoy testing, analysing data, identifying opportunities, and continuously optimising campaigns to improve results.



You will be responsible for managing and 
 paid advertising campaigns across
, Instagram, and Google, with the ultimate goal of turning cold and warm traffic into leads, subscribers, community members, customers, and sales.



This is a full-time position working Monday to Friday during Australian business hours. It is not suitable for candidates looking for part-time, freelance, or gig work.



ABOUT THE ROLE



As our Media Buyer, you will take ownership of the performance of paid advertising campaigns across multiple accounts.



You will work closely with our creative, content, development, and marketing teams to ensure campaigns are properly set up, tracked, tested, and continuously improved.



You will not be responsible for writing ad copy, designing graphics, or editing videos.



Instead, your focus will be on understanding what converts, testing different creative and audience combinations, analysing performance, and making data-driven decisions to improve campaign results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Campaign Management & Optimisation



Manage and 
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.



Manage Google Ads campaigns where required.



Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.



Continuously test different videos, images, messaging, audiences, offers, placements, and campaign structures.



Analyse campaign data and make informed optimisation decisions.



Scale campaigns that are performing well while identifying and addressing underperforming campaigns.



Optimise campaigns to improve conversion rates and overall return on advertising spend.



Monitor budgets and ensure advertising spend is being allocated effectively.



Identify trends, performance issues, and opportunities before they become major problems.



Testing & Performance



We want someone who genuinely enjoys testing, testing, and testing again.



You will be expected to:



Test different creative assets and variations.



Test different audiences and targeting strategies.



Test different campaign structures and approaches.



Identify winning combinations and scale them.



Quickly recognise what is not working and make changes.



Use campaign data to continuously improve performance.



Develop and communicate clear testing hypotheses.



Tracking & Conversion



Work with developers to establish appropriate tracking for each account.



Assist with setting up general tracking and conversion tracking.



Ensure campaigns are accurately measuring the desired conversion events.



Monitor tracking and identify potential issues or inconsistencies.



Ensure campaign data is reliable enough to support optimisation decisions.



Help ensure the customer journey is properly tracked from advertisement through to conversion.



Funnel & Campaign Congruency



Ensure consistency between advertisements, landing pages, offers, and the overall customer journey.



Identify gaps or inconsistencies that may negatively affect conversion rates.



Work with the broader marketing team to improve the relationship between traffic, landing pages, content, and offers.



Understand the difference between generating traffic and generating qualified conversions.



Lead Generation & Conversion



Depending on the account, campaigns may be designed to convert cold and warm traffic into:



Subscribers



Leads containing name,
, and phone number



 Group members



Customers



Sales



Other defined conversion actions



Your responsibility is to help turn paid traffic into measurable business outcomes, not simply clicks or impressions.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this role means becoming someone the team can rely on to consistently improve advertising performance through testing, analysis, and optimisation.



In your first 30–60 days, success looks like:



You understand our accounts, campaigns, audiences, funnels, offers, and conversion goals.



Campaigns are properly structured and monitored.



Tracking and conversion events are working correctly.



You can confidently identify campaign performance issues and opportunities.



You are actively testing new creative, audiences, and campaign approaches.



You can clearly explain why you are making specific optimisation decisions.



As you become established in the role, success looks like:



Campaign performance is continuously improving.



You consistently identify and scale winning campaigns and creative.



Poor-performing campaigns are identified and addressed quickly.



You develop a strong understanding of what works for different audiences and offers.



Cost per lead, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, and other relevant KPIs are actively managed.



Advertising budgets are allocated based on performance and opportunity.



Tracking issues are identified and resolved quickly.



You contribute meaningful insights and recommendations to the wider marketing team.



Ultimately, success means:



You can take responsibility for paid traffic performance and demonstrate that your work is generating measurable results for our clients and the business.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply manage ads — we want someone who thinks like a performance marketer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential



2+ years of proven hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns.



Strong experience with
 Ads and Instagram Ads.



Experience with Google Ads.



Demonstrated experience managing and optimising campaigns based on performance data.



Strong understanding of paid advertising and lead generation.



Experience with conversion tracking and campaign tracking.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



Ability to interpret campaign data and turn insights into action.



Strong attention to detail.



Ability to work independently and take ownership of campaign performance.



Fast and reliable internet connection.



Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Ability to work full-time Monday to Friday during Australian business hours.



We especially value people who:



Are naturally curious and love testing new ideas.



Think in terms of data, outcomes, and ROI.



Don't become emotionally attached to campaigns or creative that isn't working.



Are proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.



Can identify problems and propose solutions.



Are comfortable managing multiple campaigns/accounts.



Take ownership of results.



Are constantly looking for ways to improve performance.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...



You are looking for a part-time or gig-based position.



You have only theoretical knowledge of
 or Google Ads.



You have never managed real advertising budgets.



You prefer to simply follow instructions rather than analyse and optimise.



You don't enjoy working with numbers and performance data.



You are uncomfortable with continuous testing and experimentation.



You consider a campaign "finished" once it has been launched.



WORKING HOURS



Full-Time



Monday to Friday

Australian business hours



You must be available to work consistently during the required Australian business hours.



HOW TO APPLY



If you are an experienced Media Buyer who loves testing, optimisation, data, and getting measurable results, we would love to hear from you.



Please send the link to your CV when applying.



When applying, please also briefly tell us about your experience managing
/Instagram and Google Ads campaigns and the types of results you have achieved.

title: Senior Accountant – Xero/XPM | NZ Accounting & Property Tax Practice
description:
Senior Accountant – Xero/XPM | NZ Accounting & Property Tax Practice



Location: Philippines (remote)  

Hours: Full-time preferred (40 hours per week), with a 4-day-per-week arrangement considered for the right person  

Experience: Minimum 5 years; ideally 10+ years in accounting/bookkeeping or public practice  

Start: As soon as possible  



About MyTaxMate (
)



MyTaxMate is a growing New Zealand accounting and tax advisory practice. We work with individuals, small businesses, companies, trusts, Look-Through Companies (LTCs), and property investors.



A significant part of our work involves residential rental properties, property structures, GST, annual accounts, income tax returns, payroll, and client support. We are not a high-volume compliance factory. We value accurate work, practical thinking, clear communication, and building long-term client relationships.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant who can become a trusted part of the team, initially managing accounting and compliance work and progressively taking greater ownership of client communication and job management.



The role



You will prepare and manage work across a portfolio of New Zealand clients. This will include accounting, reconciliations, GST, annual accounts, tax-return preparation, rental-property accounts, document follow-up, and communicating with clients.



You must be comfortable working independently, identifying issues rather than simply processing information, and escalating technical or judgment-based matters when needed.



Over time, we want this role to take more responsibility for client contact, including requesting information, following up outstanding queries, explaining routine accounting matters in plain English, and keeping jobs moving.



Key responsibilities



- Manage a portfolio of client jobs from information collection through to review.

- Reconcile Xero files, including bank, credit-card, loan, shareholder-current-account, and clearing accounts.

- Prepare draft GST returns and identify transactions requiring client clarification.

- Prepare annual financial statements, working papers, and draft income tax returns.

- Prepare rental-property accounts for individuals, joint owners, companies, LTCs and trusts.

- Allocate and review property income and expenses, including rent, interest, rates, insurance, property-management fees, repairs and maintenance, legal costs, chattels and depreciation.

- Assist with company, trust and LTC accounting work.

- Review transactions for business versus private treatment and GST treatment.

- Prepare clear client query lists and follow up clients for outstanding information.

- Maintain accurate job status, budgets, notes and deadlines in Xero Practice Manager (XPM).

- Assist with payroll, PAYE, bookkeeping and routine administration where required.

- Prepare professional draft
s to clients and respond to routine client queries.

- Identify missing information, unusual movements, duplicate transactions, coding issues and potential tax/accounting risks.

- Work closely with the founder on complex tax, property, structuring and IRD matters.



Essential requirements



- At least 5 years’ accounting experience, preferably in an accounting firm or outsourced accounting environment.

- Ideally 10+ years’ experience.

- Strong practical experience using:

  - Xero

  - Xero Practice Manager (XPM)

  - Microsoft Excel and Word

  - Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Drive and Google Sheets

- Experience preparing financial statements, workpapers, GST returns and income tax returns.

- Excellent bank reconciliation and bookkeeping skills.

- Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with clients.

- Ability to manage several jobs at once, prioritise deadlines and follow up without being chased.

- High attention to detail and a strong review mindset.

- Comfortable asking sensible questions and raising issues early.

- Reliable internet, suitable home-office setup and availability during New Zealand business hours, at least partly.



Preferred experience



The following is highly desirable, but we are also happy to train the right experienced accountant:



- Experience with New Zealand accounting, tax or compliance work.

- Experience with Xero Tax.

- Knowledge of New Zealand GST, PAYE, provisional tax and IRD processes.

- Experience preparing accounts for New Zealand rental properties or property investors.

- Familiarity with New Zealand property-tax concepts, including interest deductibility, residential rental-loss ring-fencing, ownership structures, LTCs, trusts, companies, depreciation and GST considerations.

- Experience dealing directly with clients by
 or video call.

- Experience with Ignition, myIR, Google Forms, Calendly or similar practice-management tools.

- Experience working with Australian or New Zealand accounting firms.



You will suit this role if you are someone who:



- Takes ownership of your work and follows matters through to completion.

- Does not guess when information is unclear.

- Can distinguish between routine work and matters that need review.

- Enjoys dealing with clients professionally and building trust.

- Is organised, calm under deadlines and commercially aware.

- Can prepare work to a high standard before sending it for review.

- Wants a long-term role where your responsibility and client exposure can grow.



What we offer



- Long-term remote role with a growing New Zealand accounting practice.

- Full-time role preferred, with four days per week considered for the right candidate.

- Opportunity to develop into a senior client-management role.

- Direct exposure to NZ accounting, tax, property-investment and advisory work.

- Support and training on our systems, processes and New Zealand-specific requirements.

- A professional but friendly working environment where good work and initiative are valued.

- Competitive remuneration based on experience, capability and hours worked.



How to apply



Please apply with:



1. Your CV/resume.

2. A short cover letter explaining your experience with Xero, XPM and client communication.

3. Details of your experience preparing financial statements, GST returns and income tax returns.

4. Any New Zealand or Australian accounting/tax experience.

5. Your preferred working arrangement: full-time or four days per week.

6. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

7. Your internet speed and usual availability in New Zealand business hours.

8. A brief answer to this question:

When reviewing a Xero file before preparing a GST return or annual accounts, what are the first five things you would check?



Please begin your application with the words: “Detail matters.” This helps us identify applicants who have read the full advertisement.



Only applicants with strong Xero experience, excellent English, and genuine senior-accounting capability will be considered.

We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself: 



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡

Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.

Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗬 (𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽):

 handle

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.

title: Senior Payroll Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Payroll Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



-You’ll play an important role in ensuring our people are paid accurately and on time. Your responsibilities will include:

-Processing Australian and Contractor’s payroll accurately and on schedule

-Managing payroll changes, including new starters, salary updates, leave, allowances, and terminations

-Reviewing timesheets and payroll data to ensure accuracy

-Assisting with PAYG, superannuation, leave entitlements, STP, and other payroll requirements

-Reconciling payroll reports and investigating discrepancies

-Responding to employee payroll queries in a timely and professional manner

-Working closely with our Finance and People Operations teams

-Supporting payroll reporting, audits, and process improvements



What We’re Looking For



We’d love to hear from you if you have:

-3+ years experience as a Payroll Officer or similar payroll role

-Experience processing Australian payroll

-A good understanding of PAYG, superannuation, leave entitlements, and Australian payroll requirements

-Strong attention to detail and excellent numerical skills

-Experience using payroll and accounting software

-Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

-The ability to manage deadlines and work independently

-Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

-A high level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information

-A qualification or relevant studies in Accounting, Finance, Payroll, or a related field.

-Experience working in a fast-paced or high-growth business.



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: Contact Enrichment & Automation Specialist
description:
I’m looking to hire full time for one who can build a working contact-enrichment system—not just recommend software.



What we want



Our team adds business contacts to a Google Sheet. The system fills in missing information:



First name · Last name · Company · Job title · LinkedIn profile link · Profile photo, where available



The results stay organized, uncertain matches are flagged, and our team can run the next batch without needing a developer.



What you’ll do



1. Prove it works.

Run a paid pilot with 30 eligible contacts. Show us the results, accuracy, missing information, and cost. Our list includes international contacts, particularly Saudi Arabia and the UAE.



2. Build the workflow.

Choose the right tools, connect them to Google Sheets, prevent duplicate processing, and make the system easy to operate. Confirm that the providers support our inputs, countries, and intended use before we buy subscriptions.



3. Hand it over.

Deliver the working automation, a short video walkthrough, and clear instructions. Our team should be able to add contacts, run a batch, and review the results.



Use supported integrations with publicly listed business-contact information or contacts who have agreed to enrichment. Accuracy matters more than filling every cell.



Who we’re looking for



You’ve built contact-enrichment workflows before using Clay, APIs, Make, n8n, or similar tools. You know how to distinguish a reliable professional-profile match from a guess.



We’re open to your recommended stack. What matters is that it works.



To apply



Send one example of a similar system you personally built, your proposed approach, and your price for the pilot. Separate your fee from software and data costs.



Answer one question:



“How would you prevent the wrong LinkedIn profile from being matched to a contact?”



We’ll start with the paid pilot and move to the full build once the results are proven.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
You own the list. Not the application that displays it, not the outreach that goes out from it — **the list itself**, and the machinery that keeps it accurate, ranked, and fresh.



Why this role exists



We're a bootstrapped B2B services company. Our sharpest buying signal is a public event that tells us an account has just moved in-market — a 
nt when what we sell becomes urgent rather than interesting.



That signal is buried in third-party data feeds. Millions of records a week. Maybe two thousand matter to us.



Right now, finding those two thousand is guesswork wearing a lab coat. A query someone wrote once, a filter nobody has re-tuned since, and a number at the end that nobody can defend.



Your work is to make that number defensible, then make it bigger without making it worse.





What you'll own



1. The signal pipeline

Third-party data feeds ? filtered ? deduplicated ? scored ? landed in our database. You design the queries. You tune the filters. You own the credit budget and every coverage tradeoff inside it.



2. The account universe

Not just the inbound flow — the full stock of companies that could ever buy from us. Industry association directories, technographic sources, licensing registries, public company web sources. Feeds are rented. This asset is ours permanently.



3. The scoring model

Not every signal is equal. An account in our size band that just triggered our buying event is gold. An account that looks identical on paper but structurally cannot buy is noise, and noise is expensive because Sales spends real hours on it. You build the logic that separates them, and you revise it when Sales tells you it's wrong.



4. Enrichment

Company ? decision-maker ? verified contact. You own the waterfall, the match rates, and the cost per usable contact.



5. The truth

When someone asks "how many qualified signals did we get last week," you answer with a number you can walk backward to source. That sounds small. It's the entire role.







What you need to have done before



- Built and maintained a real B2B list pipeline — pulling from APIs, cleaning, deduplicating, enriching, shipping to a CRM or sequencer. Not a one-off extract. Something that ran daily and that people depended on.

- SQL, fluently. You can write the query that finds the duplicates.

- Python or equivalent for API work, pagination, rate limits, retries, and scheduled tasks.

- Worked with firmographic, technographic, or intent data providers — Apollo, Clay, ZoomInfo, People Data Labs, Bright Data, or similar. You know that a vendor's coverage claim and your actual result are two different numbers.

- Deduplication and entity resolution. Same company, four name variants, three domains. You've solved this at scale before.

- Cost discipline. You've operated inside a credit budget and made tradeoffs rather than just asking for a bigger plan.



What helps



- Exposure to B2B services, real estate, or professional services verticals

- Clay, Instantly, Supabase, or comparable tooling

- Technographic tools (BuiltWith, Wappalyzer)

- Comfort writing a short memo that says "our number is wrong, and here's why"



What this role is not



- Not a scraper-builder. We buy data where buying beats building. You'll need judgment about which is which, and the default answer is usually "buy."

- Not a full-stack developer. Engineering builds the product. You own the data moving through it.

- Not an SDR. You don't send the outreach. You make sure it reaches the right people.

- Not set-and-forget. The ICP moves. Vendors quietly change coverage. Filters rot. If you want to build something once and walk away, this will frustrate you.



---



How we'll measure it



- Qualified signals per week — and whether that number survives an audit

- Precision — Tier A accounts Sales agrees were worth a call

- Cost per qualified account

- Freshness — hours from signal appearing to account landing

- Duplicate rate — trending down, every month

>> I'm wanting to work with women only (I want to support women!). 



I'm a neurodivergence coach originally from Korea, now living in LA. I work with creative, multi-passionate adults who want to build fulfilling lives by working with their nervous system.



My business and life are growing very quickly, and I need an exceptional operations manager / executive assistant—someone in the top 5–10%—to help me take things to the next level.



You'll be my operational partner, making decisions on my behalf and keeping both my business and personal life running smoothly.



I'd love for us to become friends, not just employer-employee. I've experienced this with my previous assistants and it's been really fulfilling.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You'll be acting on my behalf—calling banks, vendors, and service providers, making real-time decisions, and managing personal and business logistics independently.



This is a dynamic, fast-paced and constantly evolving role. Things move quickly without step-by-step instructions, and you'll need exceptional judgment and discretion.



If you love taking initiative, solving problems creatively, and owning projects end-to-end, this could be the perfect role for you.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Keep in communication with vendors, service providers—handle situations independently

- Keep track of different dates & deadlines and follow through until completion

- Managing and maintaining multiple projects, tasks and systems

- Conduct in-depth research and troubleshoot issues

- Manage bookkeeping for business and personal finances





WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE



- Highly independent and proactive, able to act and d
 on my behalf across personal and business matters

- Exceptional decision-making and sound judgment in a variety of contexts and situations

- Clear, concise, and direct communicator – able to give clear feedback on what is working, what is not, suggestions & improvements

- Adaptable and resourceful, able to navigate new tools, platforms, and situations quickly

- Exceptionally organized and able to prioritize very effectively when many things feel time-sensitive

- Able to own and execute projects from beginning to end

- Comfortable managing complex and multiple priorities without dropping anything (daily tasks PLUS multiple side projects—all at once)





HOURS



- 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday PST (Tuesday–Saturday PH time preferred but weekend time can be adjusted)

- Will meet, do work together, and do dody-doubling (co-working) at 4PM to 9 PM PST (7 or 8 am - 12nn or 1 am)





PAY & BENEFITS



- $1,400–$1,700/month, pay increases as you grow

- Severance pay

- 30 days off per year (flexible)





MY COMMITMENT TO YOU

I treat my teammates with respect and love. We're constantly learning and evolving together. I'm interested in you as a human being, beyond just our work—and I'll compensate you fairly and generously for outstanding work.





DON'T APPLY IF:



- You're early in your career without proven project / operations managing experience

- You struggle with independent decision-making or need guidance on execution

- You feel overwhelmed in high-responsibility, high-autonomy environments

- You're looking for a short-term role or stepping stone

- You feel uncertain or hesitant about this role

- Preferably 35 years old up

title: Full time Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
Role: DIGITAL MARKETING COORDINATOR



ABOUT THE BUSINESS:



We are a fast-growing digital marketing business helping global personalities, experts, and professionals grow their businesses through strategic content promotion, lead generation, and paid advertising.



Our goal is simple: Get the right content in front of the right audience and turn attention into qualified leads and sales.**



We work with a specialist team of media buyers, graphic designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and marketing professionals to deliver high-performing campaigns for our clients.



 ABOUT THE ROLE:



We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Coordinator to take ownership of coordinating client marketing campaigns from planning through to launch.



You will work closely with clients and our internal delivery team to ensure campaigns are strategically aligned, delivered on time, high quality, and ready to perform.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



Campaign Management



* Plan and coordinate multiple marketing and lead generation campaigns from concept through to launch.

* Manage timelines, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies.

* Coordinate clients, media buyers, designers, video editors, content writers, developers, and other specialists.

* Ensure everyone understands what needs to be delivered and when.



 Campaign Strategy & Quality Control



* Identify the #1 pain point the campaign is solving and ensure it is relevant to the target audience.

* Ensure consistent messaging across the entire customer journey, including **ads, creative, landing pages, lead magnets, funnels,
s, and calls to action**.

* Review campaign assets and identify gaps, errors, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

* Ensure campaigns are as strong as possible before going live.



Content & Optimisation



* Review, rewrite, and optimise ad copy, landing page copy, funnel copy,
 copy, headlines, and calls to action** when required.

* Ensure messaging is clear, compelling, consistent, and aligned with the campaign objective.



Problem Solving & Launch



* Identify roadblocks, missing information, risks, and issues early.

* Proactively solve problems and escalate issues when necessary.

* Conduct final campaign checks before launch.

* Organise and document all campaign assets and information.

* Provide a clear handover to the Media Buyer for post-launch management and optimisation.



SOFTWARE & TOOLS



You will use:



*GHL— CRM

*Zoom — Meetings & client communication

*Loom— Screen recordings

*Slack— Team communication

*ClickUp— Project management

*Gmail —

*Google Drive— File management

*Google Sheets — Tracking & reporting



Experience with these tools is an advantage, but we can provide training.



REQUIREMENTS



This role is ideal for someone who:



* Has 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, campaign coordination, project management, lead generation, or a similar role.

* Understands paid digital advertising and lead generation.

* Is highly organised and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Can confidently communicate with clients and internal team members.

* Has strong problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership abilities.

* Is proactive and takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Has excellent attention to detail and a results-driven mindset.

* Enjoys working with creative, marketing, and technical specialists.

* Is eager to learn, improve, and take on greater responsibility.



The Type of person we're looking for:



We are looking for someone who:



*Thinks ahead.

*Takes ownership.

*Spots problems early.

*Solves problems proactively.

*Communicates clearly.

*Pays attention to detail.

*Works well with others.

*Wants to learn and improve.



You don't need to know everything on Day 1. We will train you on our systems and processes.

What we do need is someone with the attitude, initiative, and work ethic to become exceptional at the role.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



You will be successful when:



* Campaigns launch on time with minimal delays or last-minute issues.

* Projects are organised and everyone knows what they are responsible for.

* Campaigns are high quality with strong and consistent messaging across every touchpoint.

* Problems are identified early and resolved proactively rather than becoming larger issues.

* Clients are well communicated with and feel confident that their campaigns are being managed professionally.

* Team members have what they need to complete their work efficiently.

* Campaign handovers are complete and organised allowing Media Buyers to take over smoothly.

* You consistently identify opportunities to improve campaigns, messaging, and processes**.

* You require progressively less supervision because you understand what needs to be done and take initiative.

* Ultimately, the campaigns you coordinate contribute to quality leads, sales, and measurable growth for our clients.**



The ultimate measure of success:



*Clients are happy.

*Campaigns launch on time.

*The work is high quality.

*The team is organised.

*Problems are solved before they become problems.

*Our campaigns generate results.**







HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your **CV/resume and cover letter** explaining:



1. Your relevant digital marketing experience.

2. Your experience coordinating or managing marketing campaigns.

3. Your experience with paid advertising and/or lead generation.

4. Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.

title: Customer Service Representative — US Fashion Store (English, long term)
description:
Customer Service Representative — US Fashion Store (English, long term)



ABOUT THE WORK



We run an online women's fashion store selling to customers in the United States. Our customers are mostly women aged 45 and over, and they expect patience and real care when something goes wrong with an order.



Read this part carefully, because it is unusual and it is the whole job.



We built our own helpdesk. Every ticket that comes in already has a reply drafted by AI, based on our customer service handbook. You do not write
s from scratch. You judge the ones that have been written. You read her message, open her order, read the draft, and d
 whether it is right — right situation, right offer, right amount, nothing promised we cannot deliver. If it is right you send it. If it is not, you fix it or reject it.



Nothing reaches a customer without you.



That means the quality of our customer service is your judgement, not the AI's. The draft is fast; d
 whether it is correct is the job. Some people find that satisfying and are excellent at it. Others are bored within a week. Be honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.



WHAT A TICKET LOOKS LIKE FROM YOUR SIDE



- Read the customer's
 in full, plus her earlier messages to us

- Open her order and check what she bought, what she paid, and what shipped

- Read the prepared draft

- Check it against the handbook: the right situation, the right offer, the right amount, nothing promised that we cannot deliver, nothing we are never allowed to say

- Correct what does not fit her
, then send

- Log the case: the template code, what she agreed to, what needs following up

- Create a row for our supplier when they need to act, and pass it on



WHAT YOU D



This is not a button-pressing job. Within the handbook you have real authority from the start, and nobody checks these before you act:



- Whether the AI picked the right situation at all. It drafts from what she wrote; you d
 whether that is really what her
 is about, and you reject a draft that misses her point.

- Cashback up to 50% of the order. You read her case, you pick the rung, you send it.

- A replacement at her cost, or a free item of her choice as a final offer.

- Every judgement that turns on a photo — a real fault against ordinary wear, a wrong item, a missing piece. The AI never makes that call. You look at the photos and you d
.

- Whether a situation the handbook has never seen can be answered safely, or has to come to us first.



Two things stay with us, and they are about where the money sits, not about trust: anything above 50%, and the actual paying out. You log what she agreed to, we transfer it.



The one rule that does not bend is that you never invent an offer in front of a customer. Every number comes from the handbook. If the handbook is wrong, you say so and we change it, which brings us to the next part.



WHERE WE WANT YOUR OWN THINKING



The person we want is the opposite of passive. You will read every ticket we get, which means you see things before we do:



- A situation the handbook does not cover. Tell us, and it becomes a template. Anything that comes up three times gets its own code.

- A template that keeps needing the same correction. That is our problem, not yours to quietly patch every day. Flag it and we fix the template.

- A product that generates complaints out of proportion to its sales. You will spot that weeks before it shows up in our numbers.

- A supplier issue appearing across several orders at once.

- Anything in our process that makes your work slower than it needs to be.



We go through these every week and d
 what becomes a rule. The handbook is built to grow, and the person reading every ticket is the one who knows where it falls short.



What we do not want is someone who improvises in front of the customer and mentions it afterwards. Flag it, follow the handbook until we have changed it, then it is changed for everyone.



EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who has already done customer service for a fashion dropshipping store. That is the main thing. If you have handled the usual cases — late deliveries, wrong sizes, damaged items, customers threatening their bank, a supplier shipping from Asia with long transit times — you will recognise everything in our handbook on day one.



On top of that:



- Excellent written English. Not textbook grammar, but warm, natural, full sentences that read as if a real person wrote them.

- Very careful. The whole job is noticing the one detail in her
 that the draft missed.

- Able to work inside a written system precisely, and to argue with the system rather than quietly stepping outside it.

- Reliable on your shift, and quick to say you are stuck rather than guessing.

- Comfortable with AI tools. You will work alongside one all day and you need to be able to tell when it is wrong.

- Stable internet and a computer that handles several browser tabs.



WHERE THIS GOES



We are going from one rep to a small team. Whoever learns this handbook properly is the person who trains the next reps, reviews their work, and has a hand in what the handbook says. The limits above move as we learn what someone can carry.



We are hiring slowly and paying for a trial because we are looking for that person, not for a pair of hands.



HOURS



6 to 8 hours a day, 5 days a week, during US business hours. That means your shift falls in the evening and night in the Philippines. Only apply if that works for you long term.



We occasionally need weekend cover. Not every week, and we ask rather than assume.



Tickets are answered within 4 hours during your shift, so we need you at your desk during those hours, not checking in occasionally.



PAY



4 to 5 USD per hour to start, depending on your experience. The first two weeks are a paid trial at 4 USD per hour, so we can both see whether this is a fit. Paid weekly.



The rate moves up from there on quality and experience, not on time served. As you take on more of the judgement in this role, the pay follows.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with a red apple emoji. This is how we filter out automated applications. Anything without it is not read.



Do not send a standard application letter. We will not read it.



First, do this. Below is a customer
 and a draft reply, exactly as you would see them on your first day. Tell us in your own words what is wrong with the draft and what you would change before sending it.



Customer: "I ordered two blouses three weeks ago and only one arrived. The box was open at one end when it got here. I am not happy and I would like to know what you are going to do about this."



Draft reply: "Dear Maria, thank you for your
. I am sorry your order has been delayed. Your parcel is still in transit and should arrive within 8 to 14 business days. Please let me know if you have any other questions."



Then tell us:



- Which fashion store or stores you did customer service for, and roughly how many tickets a day

- Have you worked in Shopify admin? What did you do in it — orders, refunds, products?

- Have you used Claude or ChatGPT in your work? For what, and how often?

- What hours you can work, in Philippine time



We read every reply that answers the draft question, and we answer the ones that are a fit.

title: Full-Stack WordPress Developer
description:
ABOUT BRAND M3DIA



Brand M3dia is a Canadian technology company specializing in interactive kiosks, AI robots, digital signage, custom software, websites, and automation. We serve clients across Canada and the United States.



Approximately 80% of our past website work has been WordPress. We’re expanding into custom web applications and AI-powered solutions, and we’re looking for a developer who can support both.



THE ROLE



We need a hands-on developer who can handle front-end and back-end development, build polished Elementor websites, troubleshoot existing projects, and create custom functionality.



We encourage AI-assisted development and vibe coding. You must understand, test, debug, and maintain the code you deliver.



You’ll work with our project manager, designers, marketing team, and leadership to turn approved ideas into reliable websites and working tools.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Build and maintain WordPress websites using Elementor Pro and custom code.

• Turn approved designs into polished, responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile pages.

• Develop custom functionality using PHP, JavaScript, WordPress hooks, child themes, and plugins.

• Build landing pages, calculators, lead-capture tools, and simple web applications.

• Connect websites and forms to CRMs and other platforms through APIs and webhooks.

• Troubleshoot plugin conflicts, broken layouts, failed integrations, and performance issues.

• Manage staging sites, updates, backups, migrations, and deployment checks.

• Use AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.

• Test your work and provide clear handover notes.



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Strong WordPress and Elementor Pro experience.

• Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.

• Experience building custom functionality beyond installing plugins.

• Working knowledge of MySQL and safe database operations.

• Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication.

• Git version control using GitHub or an equivalent platform.

• Understanding of responsive design, website performance, accessibility basics, and security.

• Experience with staging environments, backups, and rollback procedures.

• Practical experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools.

• Clear English communication and strong troubleshooting skills.



You must be comfortable taking over existing websites and code, understanding how they work, and improving them.



BONUS SKILLS



• React, Next.js, or another modern front-end framework.

• Node.js or Python.

• 
, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.

• Zoho CRM, AI APIs, or chatbot integrations.

• Technical SEO, analytics, and conversion tracking.

• Touchscreen interfaces or browser-based kiosk applications.



You do not need experience with every bonus tool.



HOW WE WORK



• Submit a short daily plan and keep your Basecamp tasks updated.

• Provide an end-of-day report with completed work, links or screenshots, remaining tasks, and blockers.

• Confirm requirements and realistic timelines before starting substantial work.

• Raise problems early, explain what you’ve tried, and recommend a next step.

• Follow through on outstanding tasks without repeated reminders.

• Test layouts, forms, integrations, and relevant error cases before marking work complete.

• Keep code and documentation organized in company-controlled accounts.

• Follow company rules for client data, credentials, and AI tools.



We value initiative, clear communication, and reliable follow-through. “Done” means the work functions, has been checked, and is ready for review.



WHY JOIN US?



• Work on websites, interactive technology, and practical AI projects.

• Collaborate with designers, marketing, and technical teammates.

• Help improve our tools and development processes.

• Opportunity for long-term growth across software and automation projects.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line:

Full-Stack WordPress Developer — [Your Name]



Include the following:



Your résumé.



Your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Your earliest start date and available working hours, including your overlap with Toronto time.



Two WordPress websites you personally developed. For each, briefly explain what you built yourself.



One example of custom PHP/JavaScript, an API integration, or a back-end feature you developed.



A link to the short video described below.



If your projects are private, a redacted walkthrough is welcome. Do not share confidential client code or credentials.



REQUIRED VIDEO — 4–6 MINUTES



Record a simple introduction and screen-share video using Loom or a similar tool. No editing or polished presentation is needed. We want to understand your experience, how you think, and what you personally built.



Please answer these questions:



Tell us briefly about yourself, your development experience, and why this role interests you.



Show one WordPress project you’re proud of. What did you personally build, and which parts used Elementor versus custom code?



Describe a back-end feature or API integration you developed. What happened to the data after the user submitted or requested it?



Which AI coding tools do you use? Give one real example of how AI helped you and how you checked or corrected its output.



Describe a difficult bug you solved. How did you identify the cause and verify the fix?



If a task is blocked or likely to miss its deadline, how do you communicate that and keep the work moving?



Please check that your video link is accessible without requesting permission.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a live project walkthrough and a paid practical assessment.



AI tools are allowed during the assessment. You must be able to explain your code, demonstrate that it works, and make a small change live.



Applications without relevant project examples, answers to the requested application details, and the required video will not be considered.

title: Senior AI Voice Engineer — Conversational AI / Voice Agents
description:
We’re looking for an exceptional AI Voice Engineer who has already built production AI phone agents that sound remarkably human.



The goal is simple:



Build an AI phone agent where the conversation feels so natural, fast, and fluid that it feels dramatically better than typical AI calling platforms.



We are specifically interested in a stack involving:



Grok / xAI + ElevenLabs + Twilio/SIP + custom integrations



This is not a basic chatbot project.



We care obsessively about:



* Extremely realistic human voice

* Very low conversational latency

* Natural interruptions / barge-in

* Knowing when the caller has actually finished speaking

* Natural pauses and pacing

* Short, conversational responses instead of robotic paragraphs

* Emotion, tone, and conversational variation

* Handling people who interrupt, change their minds, hesitate, or speak unclearly

* Function calling and real-world actions during calls

* Call transfers

* Scheduling appointments

* CRM integration

* Full transcripts, recordings, outcomes, and analytics

* Reliable outbound and inbound calling at scale



What You’ll Build



A production-quality AI calling system where:



Caller speaks → speech is understood → Grok determines the response/action → ElevenLabs generates extremely realistic speech → response happens naturally over the phone.



The agent should be able to:



* Have genuine back-and-forth conversations

* Interrupt and be interrupted naturally

* Remember context throughout the call

* Ask intelligent follow-up questions

* Handle objections

* Schedule meetings

* Transfer qualified callers to a human

* Access information through APIs

* Update our CRM automatically

* Trigger workflows after calls

* Classify call outcomes

* Generate summaries and next actions



We want the system engineered for real production use, not just a demo.



You Should Already Have Experience With



We strongly prefer someone who has personally built and deployed AI voice agents using several of the following:



* ElevenLabs Conversational AI / ElevenLabs Agents

* ElevenLabs real-time voice models

* xAI / Grok APIs

* OpenAI-compatible LLM APIs

* Twilio Voice

* SIP / telephony infrastructure

* WebSockets / streaming audio

* Speech-to-text

* Text-to-speech

* VAD / turn detection

* Interruption / barge-in handling

* Function calling / tool use

* CRM integrations

* Calendly / Google Calendar integrations

* Webhooks

* Call recording and transcription

* Real-time latency optimization

* Prompt engineering specifically for spoken conversations



Experience with systems such as Vapi, Retell, Bland, LiveKit, Pipecat, Deepgram, Cartesia, or similar platforms is useful — but we are looking for someone capable of going beyond an off-the-shelf implementation.



VERY IMPORTANT



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily:



* Chatbots

* Basic OpenAI API integrations

* Simple ElevenLabs text-to-speech

* No-code AI automations

* Voice-agent demos that were never used in production



We specifically want someone who can say:



“Yes, I have already built real AI phone agents like this.”



When Applying



Send us:



1. A recording or phone number of the best AI voice agent you have personally built.

2. Explain the exact stack you used.

3. Tell us approximately what the end-to-end conversational latency was.

4. Explain how you handled:

    * interruptions

    * turn detection

    * silence

    * background noise

    * voi

    * call transfers

5. Tell us what you would use today to build the most human-sounding AI phone agent possible and why.

6. Tell us specifically what you have built using:

    ElevenLabs, Twilio, Grok/xAI, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, or similar technology.

7. Put the words “HUMAN VOICE” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the full posting.



What Success Looks Like



We should be able to call the finished system and think:



“This is completely different from the normal AI phone bots I’ve heard.”



Fast.



Warm.



Natural.



Intelligent.



Interruptible.



Not scripted.



Not robotic.



Not full of awkward pauses.



We will judge the work primarily by how the actual phone call feels, not by how impressive the architecture diagram looks.



If you have already built something at this level, send us the call recording. We want to hear it.
